title: 2D Motion Graphics Designer
description:
We are looking for a -2D motion graphics designer- to produce premium, product-accurate explainer videos for the GMI platform - starting with our LP Bonds explainer (\~2:40 runtime), a partner-facing B2B sales asset used on 
 and in BD calls. This is clean, premium, modern DeFi motion design - think Stripe or Linear product videos. -Strictly no stock footage, stock images, or generic crypto visuals- (no moon rockets, laser eyes, 
 coins, token explosions). All visuals must be built from real brand assets and real product screen recordings we provide.



-Requirements-

- Proven 2D motion graphics experience in After Effects, Premiere, or Figma (please include portfolio or examples - 2D only, no 3D/live-action work needed).

- Ability to work from a locked script and structured production brief exactly as written, without altering wording, product claims, or financial/yield language without written approval.

- Ability to design around real provided assets only - brand kit, chain/partner logos, and real screen recordings of the actual product (bond minting flow, stats dashboard, Bond NFT marketplace, launchpad UI) - never stock substitutes or invented UI/data.

- Comfort following a staged approval workflow: style frames ? storyboard ? animatic ? rough cut ? final cut, without skipping ahead to full animation before sign-off.

- Understanding of safe-zone design for mobile, caption placement (.srt for web, burned-in for social cutdowns), and multi-format export (16:9 primary, 1:1 and 9:16 cutdowns).

- Attention to compliance-sensitive wording on screen (e.g., "APR" not "APY," never "compounding" or "real yield," no guaranteed-profit or guaranteed-price-appreciation implications).

- Commercial licensing awareness for any music, SFX, icons, or fonts used (no unlicensed assets).



-Terms of Employment-

1. Your pay will start at $10/hour and will be project-based

50% of it will be in ETH - which you can sell anytime

50% of it will be in GMI (vested for 18 months)

2. Deliverables are milestone-based per the approval workflow (style frames, storyboard, animatic, rough cut, final cut), with multiple rounds of revisions on storyboard/style frames.



-To apply for this position-

1. Please share Google Drive link of your 2D motion graphics portfolio (no stock-footage-based reels - we want to see original 2D animation work).

We are looking for a -2D motion graphics designer- to produce premium, product-accurate explainer videos for the GMI platform - starting with our LP Bonds explainer (\~2:40 runtime), a partner-facing B2B sales asset used on 
 and in BD calls. This is clean, premium, modern DeFi motion design - think Stripe or Linear product videos. -Strictly no stock footage, stock images, or generic crypto visuals- (no moon rockets, laser eyes, 
 coins, token explosions). All visuals must be built from real brand assets and real product screen recordings we provide.



-Requirements-

- Proven 2D motion graphics experience in After Effects, Premiere, or Figma (please include portfolio or examples - 2D only, no 3D/live-action work needed).

- Ability to work from a locked script and structured production brief exactly as written, without altering wording, product claims, or financial/yield language without written approval.

- Ability to design around real provided assets only - brand kit, chain/partner logos, and real screen recordings of the actual product (bond minting flow, stats dashboard, Bond NFT marketplace, launchpad UI) - never stock substitutes or invented UI/data.

- Comfort following a staged approval workflow: style frames ? storyboard ? animatic ? rough cut ? final cut, without skipping ahead to full animation before sign-off.

- Understanding of safe-zone design for mobile, caption placement (.srt for web, burned-in for social cutdowns), and multi-format export (16:9 primary, 1:1 and 9:16 cutdowns).

- Attention to compliance-sensitive wording on screen (e.g., "APR" not "APY," never "compounding" or "real yield," no guaranteed-profit or guaranteed-price-appreciation implications).

- Commercial licensing awareness for any music, SFX, icons, or fonts used (no unlicensed assets).

50% of it will be in GMI (vested for 18 months)

2. Deliverables are milestone-based per the approval workflow (style frames, storyboard, animatic, rough cut, final cut), with multiple rounds of revisions on storyboard/style frames.

 Handle where our recruiting team can reach out to you.

Write clear and engaging product titles and descriptions.

Upload and organize product images.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Devops Engineer
description:
ESTIMATED HOURS: On-call retainer / as-needed - NOT fixed hours, 5 hr/week (spikes during i
)



PAYMENT STRUCTURE (IMPORTANT -READ CAREFULLY):

- 50% paid in ETH (Ethereum), bi-weekly

- 50% paid in GMI token, vesting linearly over 18 months

- This is an aligned, skin-in-the-game structure

- If you want pure cash only, this role is NOT for you

- If you believe in Web3 and want long-term upside, keep reading



RESPONSE SLA: You must acknowledge any request or alert within 24 hours. Every time. This is the #1 requirement.





ABOUT US

Our team at Energi Core runs production blockchain infrastructure on AWS -EKS (Kubernetes), RDS databases, EC2 instances, RPC nodes, and indexers, across both mainnet and testnet environments. Our senior DevOps is excellent but overloaded. We need a blockchain-native engineer on standby to handle routine operations, catch problems early, and keep everything healthy.



We are past our build phase. We are not hiring someone to architect or refactor. We are hiring someone to WATCH, MAINTAIN, and FLAG.





WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Monitor RPC node health: sync status, peer count, block lag, reorg frequency

- Monitor indexer health: subgraph lag, indexing errors, data drift

- Watch RDS database pressure: CPU, connections, storage

- Monitor EKS pods, nodes, and load balancers across mainnet and testnet

- Triage alerts with blockchain-aware judgment (mainnet first)

- Run weekly cleanup: unattached EBS volumes, orphaned IPs, old snapshots, stale container images, old CloudWatch logs

- Enforce tagging, access control, and documentation standards

- Produce weekly and monthly infrastructure health reports

- Handle user onboarding and offboarding across GitLab, VPN, and AWS SSO

- Escalate production-critical or architectural issues to Senior DevOps with chain-aware context





WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No mainnet deploys, rollbacks, or architecture changes

- No validator key or signer operations

- No VPC, networking, or security group changes

- No IAM policy design

- No database migrations or schema changes

- No Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code changes

- No mainnet i
 response (you escalate immediately)

- Nothing that touches wallets, trading paths, or revenue systems



HARD REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

We have learned the hard way that generic DevOps does not work for blockchain. If you do not have ALL of the following, please do not apply:



1. Minimum 2 years of hands-on production blockchain infrastructure experience at a crypto or Web3 company (not a hobby, not a bootcamp, not a side project)



2. Proven experience operating full nodes or RPC nodes in production -Geth, Erigon, Nethermind, Reth, or equivalent



3. Proven experience running indexers or subgraphs in production -The Graph, Subsquid, Ponder, or custom-built



4. Hands-on Kubernetes / EKS experience running stateful chain workloads



5. Strong AWS fluency -EC2, EBS, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, Cost Explorer (console AND CLI)



6. kubectl fluency -get pods, describe, logs, top, delete, exec



7. Dashboard literacy -CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus



8. Discipline to respond within 24 hours, every single time, without fail



9. Genuine comfort being paid 50% ETH and 50% GMI vested over 18 months





NICE TO HAVE (BONUS)

- Experience with EVM chains (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, etc.)

- Validator operations or staking infrastructure exposure

- MEV infrastructure or block-building familiarity

- Helm, Karpenter, or Terraform (read-only is fine)

- Prior on-call rotations on blockchain infrastructure

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager



USA Immigration Lawyer / Ashoori Law



Full-Time | Remote | Independent Contractor



Independent Contractor Notice



This is a full-time independent contractor position and not an employee role. The selected candidate will be responsible for their own taxes, legal compliance, and business registrations as required by their jurisdiction.



About Us



USA Immigration Lawyer is a leading immigration law platform operated by Ashoori Law, a U.S.-based immigration law firm serving clients worldwide. Through educational content, digital marketing, and client-focused service, we help individuals, families, entrepreneurs, and investors navigate the U.S. immigration process.



We are seeking an experienced Marketing Manager to lead and execute marketing initiatives that drive qualified leads, increase consultation bookings, and support the firm's continued growth.



Position Overview



The Marketing Manager will oversee the firm's digital marketing strategy, lead generation systems, CRM operations, website optimization, and performance analytics. This role requires a combination of strategic planning, hands-on execution, and strong analytical skills.



The ideal candidate has experience managing marketing campaigns, optimizing sales funnels, and working with cross-functional teams to achieve measurable business results.



Key ResponsibilitiesPaid Advertising & Lead Generation



Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, and other digital channels.

Monitor lead quality, cost per lead (CPL), cost per consultation, and return on ad spend (ROAS).

Work with media buyers, agencies, and vendors to maximize campaign performance.

Identify new opportunities to generate qualified immigration leads.

Marketing Funnel Optimization



Improve landing page conversion rates and user experience.

Optimize consultation booking flows and intake forms.

Analyze and improve lead-to-consultation conversion rates.

Identify and eliminate funnel bottlenecks.

CRM & Marketing Automation



Manage and optimize HubSpot CRM.

Create and improve automated
 campaigns and nurture sequences.

Build workflows that increase engagement and consultation bookings.

Track lead lifecycle stages and conversion performance.

Website & SEO Optimization



Collaborate with developers to improve website functionality and user experience.

Ensure website performance, speed, and conversion best practices.

Support SEO initiatives to increase organic traffic and visibility.

Monitor and improve website analytics and user behavior metrics.

Content & Brand Marketing



Coordinate content creation across blogs, videos,
 marketing, and social media.

Ensure consistent brand messaging across all channels.

Develop marketing campaigns that support firm growth objectives.

Collaborate with attorneys and subject matter experts to create educational immigration content.

Reporting & Analytics



Track and report on key marketing KPIs, including:



Lead volume

Cost per lead

Consultation booking rate

Conversion rates

Revenue attribution

Return on marketing investment

Provide leadership with actionable insights and recommendations to improve performance.



Required Qualifications



3+ years of digital marketing experience.

Proven experience managing paid advertising campaigns.

Strong HubSpot CRM experience.

Experience with lead generation and conversion optimization.

Strong analytical and reporting skills.

Excellent communication and project management abilities.

Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented.

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications



Experience marketing legal, professional, or consulting services.

Experience working with U.S.-based companies.

Familiarity with immigration law, legal marketing, or compliance-sensitive industries.

Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and external marketing vendors.

Knowledge of SEO, content marketing, and marketing automation.

Compensation



Monthly contractor compensation is negotiable based on experience and qualifications.



Performance-based bonuses may be offered based on lead generation, consultation growth, and overall marketing performance.



To Apply



Please submit:



Resume

Summary of marketing campaigns you have personally managed

Specific results achieved, including KPIs and performance metrics

Expected monthly compensation

Confirmation that you are applying as an independent contractor

title: Australian Solar Administrator (Philippines-based, Remote)
description:
Solar Energy Enterprises (SEE) designs, delivers, and supports commercial and residential solar installations across Australia. We're looking for a Solar Administrator to own the compliance and admin backbone of our project lifecycle, from post-sale to the day a system is switched on and registered.



What you'll be doing:

- STC/BSTC rebate lodgement, start to finish — Formbay submissions, photo/signature follow-ups, CER approval tracking

- Xero-based financial admin — quoting, invoicing, weekly AR, daily reconciliation, supplier POs

- Post-installation admin — handover packs, welcome
s, AEMO DER registration, monitoring setup

- Supporting our Project Managers and sales team with whatever the job needs, day to day

- Managing operations leads through their full lifecycle, from signed contract to close-out



Required skills:

- Proficiency in Xero

- Experience navigating Formbay or comparable Australian solar compliance portals

- Strong written and spoken English — you'll be writing to customers and joining internal meetings

- Sharp attention to detail on compliance documents (STC/BSTC, AEMO, CCEW)

- Minimum 2 years in a similar role

- Full availability during Sydney business hours (9am–5pm AEST/AEDT)



Strongly preferred:

- Comfort in Canva

- Strong Google Drive organisation habits



Pay: 



AU$6–10/hour, to be confirmed against your experience during the interview process.



Tell us about real work you've done, not generic claims. If you've processed an STC/BSTC rebate end-to-end, or handled invoicing and reconciliation in Xero, walk us through it: what the situation was, what you did, and what came of it.

Base Salary + Lucrative Uncapped Commission

About Us

Acendia International is a fast?growing digital growth firm helping businesses across Western markets increase enquiries, attract more paying clients, and scale revenue through proven search and marketing solutions.

We have built a complete sales engine, and now we are looking for an experienced Sales Manager to take full ownership of performance, lead the team, and drive consistent growth.

Oversee and manage the outreach and lead generation team, ensuring consistent lead flow and quality standards

Total years of experience in sales and sales management

Examples of results you have delivered personally and with previous teams

Your largest deal values and key achievements

title: CSR & Sales Support Assistant
description:

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)



Compensation: $500 – $900+ USD/month (Based on experience and skillset)



Schedule: Monday to Friday | US Pacific Standard Time (PST Shift)



Location: Remote (Based in the Philippines)



Last Updated: May 22, 2026



???? The Mission

We are looking for more than just a regular "staff member"—we want a Rockstar CSR / Sales Support Assistant who is a genuinely fantastic human being and an aggressive, proactive problem solver.



In this role, you will be the absolute heartbeat of our client interactions and sales pipeline. This isn't just about passively answering phone calls; it’s about mastering logistics, navigating complex schedules, coordinating appointments, and keeping our front-end sales engine running smoothly. If you learn incredibly fast, obsess over the "devil in the details," and thrive in a high-growth environment where you can actively contribute to the team's wins, we want you on board.



?? What You’ll Be Doing

Active Multitasking: Confidently speak with clients on the phone while simultaneously taking detailed notes and updating live calendars in real-time.



Logistics & Calendar Coordination: Take complete control of complex appointment calendars, ensuring slots are optimized and itineraries are aligned perfectly.



Data Mastery: Utilize Google Sheets and Excel with 100?curacy to track inbound leads, update pipeline statuses, and manage daily schedules.



Proactive Executive Support: Don't just wait for a task list. Look ahead at the week to anticipate operational bottlenecks and fix them before they happen.



???? Who You Are

Curious & Sharp: You pick up on new software and systems in a flash, and you are constantly thinking about how to improve current workflows.



Resourceful: You exhaust all options to solve a problem independently first, but you possess the professional maturity to know exactly when to raise your hand for help.



Flawless Communicator: Your written and spoken English is clear, professional, and near-native.



Radically Consistent: You show up to your shift every single day with the same high energy, sharp focus, and deep commitment to excellence.



???? Position Requirements

Strong, verifiable background in Customer Service (CSR) or Sales Support/Assistance.



Advanced, expert-level comfort with Google Sheets / Excel (formulas, formatting, and data organization).



Total availability to work dedicated US Pacific Time (PST) business hours.



Rock-Solid Tech Setup: A quiet, distraction-free workspace, lightning-fast internet, and a reliable backup power solution (UPS/generator) to guarantee zero downtime.



???? What’s In It For You?

$500 – $900+ USD per month baseline salary with room for growth.



Long-term job stability with a positive, deeply supportive, and highly motivating team culture.



The opportunity to work with business leaders who value, respect, and reward your daily effort.



?? How to Apply

We value attention to detail above everything else. To fast-track your application, please complete our official intake form here:



???? Apply via our Application Form:



Note: We strictly review applications submitted through the link above. To prove you actually read this post, make sure to mention one specific thing you’ve taught yourself recently in your application to showcase your "always learning" mindset!

title: Remote Operations Manager leading to Business Integrator (EOS / Systems Focused)
description:
???? Role Overview

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: $1,500 – $2,000/month base + Performance-Based Bonuses

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST (US/Canada Pacific Standard Time)

Note: Requires early starts to align with active morning field and execution teams.



???? About the Role

Are you an executive-minded operator who loves building air-tight workflows, managing team execution, and turning high-level vision into daily reality? We are a rapidly scaling company seeking a Remote Operations Manager & Business Integrator to step in as the business owner's operational right hand.



This is a high-leverage position designed for a true leader, not an administrative assistant. You will take complete ownership of our daily fulfillment engine—protecting project profit margins in real-time, designing and optimizing scalable systems, and driving field production efficiency. We are looking for a proactive business partner who looks for repeatable processes and resolves operational friction before it impacts the bottom line.



???? EOS Practitioners Encouraged to Apply: If you are deeply familiar with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework and thrive acting as the "Integrator" to a "Visionary" owner, your skills are highly valued here!



?? Executive Responsibilities

Operational Planning & Master Scheduling: Review project scopes, client contracts, and resource allocations to build and enforce a fluid, highly efficient master production schedule.



Financial Management & Profit Protection: Actively track and analyze labor hours and project material usage daily against estimates. Monitor team pacing closely and proactively resolve margin risks.



Team Accountability & Development: Oversee logistics and resource management. Audit daily field updates, run operational tracking, and ensure team leaders start their day with crystal-clear targets and high-performance metrics.



SOP & System Architecture: Proactively identify broken or missing operational systems. Design, build, and document scalable workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to facilitate company growth.



Client Experience Oversight: Manage critical client touchpoints, handle pre-project logistics, and optimize customer communication workflows to ensure every project closes to a 5-star standard.



???? What We Offer

We believe in aggressively rewarding high performance and true ownership. Your package includes:Competitive Base Salary that honors your elite operations background.



Gross Profit & Revenue Bonuses: Take home a direct share of the project margins you protect and the operational volume you help generate.



Quality & Retention Bonuses: Extra cash rewards tied directly to high client satisfaction scores, glowing reviews, and team retention.



Uncapped Career Trajectory: A dedicated operator executing at an Integrator level has realistic, performance-driven upside to scale their On-Target Earnings (OTE) well beyond the base within 1–2 years.



???? Non-Negotiables (Critical Requirements)

title: Full-Time Shopify Website Builder / Ecommerce Website Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time Shopify Website Builder / Ecommerce Website Support Specialist to join our growing team.



Our company serves creative entrepreneurs, crafters, custom apparel businesses, gift businesses, event businesses, and small ecommerce brands. We help our clients build beautiful, functional Shopify websites that allow them to sell products, accept custom orders, showcase their brand, and grow their businesses online.



We currently have a full-time website builder on our team, but we are looking to add another skilled builder who can assist with client website projects, maintenance requests, Shopify updates, and possibly landing pages or funnel builds.



This role is perfect for someone who is experienced with Shopify, has a strong eye for clean and professional design, understands ecommerce customer flow, and can work independently while also communicating well with a team.



Responsibilities



Build new Shopify websites from start to finish using approved client branding, products, images, and business details.



Customize Shopify themes to create clean, modern, professional websites that match the client’s brand style.



Create and organize website pages such as Home, Shop, About, Contact, FAQs, Policies, Custom Order Request, Collections, and other needed pages.



Set up product listings, product descriptions, product photos, variants, pricing, collections, tags, menus, and navigation.



Create collection-based shopping experiences for businesses that sell items such as apparel, tumblers, custom gifts, graduation items, memorial products, jewelry, party rentals, bundles, team orders, and personalized products.



Set up custom order request forms, inquiry links, and clear customer order processes when needed.



Make Shopify websites easy for customers to understand, shop, and purchase from.



Upload and format product images, banners, mockups, graphics, and other website visuals.



Create or edit basic website graphics using Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar design tools.



Assist with Shopify app setup when needed, including review apps, forms,
 signup, upsells, subscriptions, bundles, product options, shipping apps, or other approved tools.



Help connect domains, payment settings, shipping settings, taxes, policies, and other basic Shopify settings.



Make regular updates for clients who have website maintenance packages, including adding new products, updating collections, changing banners, editing text, updating photos, and improving website layout.



Support our Design Club clients with Shopify-related questions, website edits, product uploads, and customer service needs.



Communicate with our design team, executive assistant, project managers, and clients when information, images, branding, product details, approvals, or other required materials are missing.



Keep website projects updated inside ClickUp, including task status, notes, missing items, completed work, and project timelines.



Use our preferred client intake system to review submitted website information, identify missing pieces, and move projects forward efficiently.



Help track how long website builds and maintenance tasks take so we can improve our production process and complete client websites quickly.



Assist with maintaining and updating our company Shopify websites as needed.



Review websites for mobile responsiveness, broken links, missing information, formatting issues, and overall customer experience before submitting for approval.



Follow internal SOPs, checklists, deadlines, and communication processes.



Communicate clearly with the team about project status, missing information, client needs, blockers, and completed tasks.



Additional Preferred Responsibilities



Experience building landing pages or sales pages is a plus.



Experience with GoHighLevel is a strong plus, but not required.



We would love to find someone who can support both Shopify website builds and landing page/funnel-style website design, but we are open to hiring someone whose main strength is Shopify.



If you have additional skills such as graphic design, funnel building,
 setup, automation, SEO, copywriting, product mockups, or ecommerce strategy, please include that in your application so we can understand where you may best fit on our team.



Required Skills



Strong experience building Shopify websites.



Strong understanding of Shopify themes, products, collections, menus, pages, apps, and settings.



Good design eye and ability to create websites that look polished, clean, and professional.



Experience with Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar design tools.



Ability to organize ecommerce products in a way that makes sense to customers.



Ability to create customer-friendly website layouts and shopping experiences.



Strong attention to detail.



Ability to follow instructions, SOPs, and project checklists.



Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



Ability to communicate clearly when information is missing or when a project is delayed.



Comfortable communicating in English through written messages.



Ability to manage multiple website projects and maintenance requests at the same time.



Comfortable using project management systems such as ClickUp.



Preferred Skills



Experience working with custom product businesses, apparel brands, gift shops, craft businesses, personalization businesses, event businesses, or service-based ecommerce businesses.



Experience with Shopify custom product options.



Experience creating website banners, product mockups, and branded graphics.



Basic SEO knowledge, including product titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, and collection descriptions.



Experience with Shopify
 marketing tools, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or Shopify
.



Experience with GoHighLevel, ClickUp, Google Drive, Loom, Slack, or similar tools.



Experience building landing pages, sales pages, lead capture pages, or funnel-style website pages.



Experience writing or improving basic website copy.



Experience troubleshooting Shopify apps and theme issues.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time position.



We are looking for someone who can work consistently, communicate daily, and be available for team check-ins as needed. Some meetings may happen during Eastern Time business hours, so availability for occasional morning or daytime meetings Eastern Time is important.



Because we bring in new clients and members regularly, we need someone who can help us complete websites efficiently while also supporting ongoing maintenance requests.



What We Are Looking For



We need someone who does not just “design pages,” but understands how to build websites that help small businesses sell.



The right person will be organized, creative, detail-oriented, dependable, and able to take a client’s business information and turn it into a professional Shopify website.



You should be able to look at a brand, understand the customer, organize the products, create a clean shopping experience, and make the website feel trustworthy and easy to use.



You should also be comfortable working with a team. This role requires communication with designers, assistants, project managers, clients, and other tea
mbers to make sure website projects keep moving.



We are looking for someone who can help us improve our website production process, complete websites faster, support maintenance clients, and become a dependable long-term part of our team.



Sample Website Styles



We will provide examples of client websites so you can understand the types of brands we work with and the style of Shopify websites we need created.



These examples include custom gift websites, apparel websites, handmade product websites, jewelry websites, event/rental websites, personalized product brands, and ecommerce businesses.



To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



How many years of Shopify experience do you have?

Please send 3–5 Shopify websites you have built or helped build.

What parts of Shopify are you strongest in: design, product uploads, apps, coding, SEO, graphic design, maintenance, or strategy?

Do you have experience building landing pages or funnels?

Do you have experience using GoHighLevel? If yes, please describe your experience.

What design tools do you use?

Have you worked with custom products, apparel, gifts, jewelry, party/event businesses, or personalized product brands before?

Are you comfortable working inside ClickUp and updating project statuses daily?

Are you comfortable communicating with tea
mbers or clients when information is missing?

Are you able to help track how long website tasks take and communicate realistic timelines?

Are you available full-time?

What is your expected monthly salary?

What other skills do you have that may be helpful to our team?

Please include the phrase “Shopify Builder” in the first line of your application so we know you read the full job post.



We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with our company and become an important part of our website and ecommerce support team.

title: QA Tester - iPhone app + website
description:
We are hiring 1-2 detail-oriented QA testers for Carby, a meal-planning iPhone app and website. This is not just a basic bug-checking role. We want someone who can go through the full user experience, notice confusing 
nts, and write clear improvement suggestions.



This starts with a short paid test assignment. The best reports will be hired for ongoing weekly QA work.



Requirements:

- You have access to a real iPhone.

- You can record your iPhone screen with microphone audio on.

- You write clear English.

- You can create a clean Google Doc report with screenshots, recordings, repro steps, and severity.

- You can test both a website and an iOS app.



To apply, start your application with the word MANGO and answer:

1. What iPhone model and iOS version do you have?

2. What QA/testing experience do you have?

3. Share one bug or confusing UX problem you found in any app or website, with repro steps in 2-3 sentences.

4. Are you comfortable recording your screen with voice narration and creating a Google Doc report?



Applications that do not start with MANGO will not be considered. This is an attention-to-detail test.



Qualified applicants will receive a short paid test assignment through a Tally form. The assignment includes:

- 30-second tech-check screen recording with microphone on.

- One continuous narrated iPhone Safari test of the Carby quiz flow.

- A $0 tester checkout flow.

- Downloading and exploring the Carby iOS app.

- A Google Doc report with device, flow tested, expected vs actual behavior, repro steps, screenshots/recordings, severity P0-P3, UX friction, and suggested fixes.



Auto-fail for the test assignment: no tech-check video, full recording has no audio, chat notes instead of a Google Doc, or missed deadline.

title: WordPress Developer (AI Integration Focus)
description:
Are you a forward-thinking WordPress Developer who loves taking ownership of projects and exploring new technologies? We are looking for someone to blend technical WordPress expertise with cutting-edge AI tools to build exceptional websites and revolutionize our development workflow. If you are excited about the future of AI in web development, we want to connect with you!



About the Role:

We’re looking for a talented and detail-driven Senior WordPress Developer to join our team. In this unique position, a significant part of your initial focus will be pioneering our AI capabilities—specifically building and implementing a workflow using Claude AI (or similar tools) to efficiently translate Figma designs into WordPress Elementor websites. Alongside driving this AI initiative, you will take charge of structuring, developing, and maintaining complex custom WordPress websites from start to finish.



Your Responsibilities:

- AI Workflow Integration (New): Develop, test, and implement an automated or AI-assisted workflow (utilizing tools like Claude AI) to convert Figma designs directly into fully functional WordPress/Elementor layouts.

- Development & Structuring: Build and customize advanced WordPress websites using Elementor, tailoring them to specific client needs.

- Data Architecture: Set up and manage complex data structures using SCF/ACF fields and JetEngine.

- E-commerce: Develop and maintain webshops using WooCommerce and Shopify.

- Custom Coding: Utilize HTML, CSS, PHP and Liquid to write, modify, and optimize custom functionalities.



What We’re Looking For:

- AI & Prompt Engineering (New): Experience with (or a strong, demonstrable aptitude for) AI models like Claude AI or ChatGPT, specifically using them to accelerate coding or development workflows.

- Design-to-Code Expertise (New): Solid understanding of Figma and how to logically break down design files for web implementation.

- Core WordPress & Shopify Skills: Demonstrated experience in developing advanced WordPress websites with extensive, hands-on knowledge of Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify theme builder.

- Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of data structuring (SCF/ACF, JetEngine) and proficiency in HTML, CSS, PHP and Liquid.

- Portfolio: A portfolio featuring at least three complex WordPress websites/platforms you have built.

- Experience: 5+ years of professional experience, with a solid understanding of performance optimization and SEO best practices.

- Language: Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

- Hosting Management (Bonus): Hands-on experience with website hosting (e.g., creating server environments, migrating/transferring websites, and troubleshooting hosting-related issues) is a strong plus.

- Basic SEO (Bonus): Knowledge of basic Search Engine Optimization (SEO) principles and best practices is a plus.



What You’ll Get:

- A creative and flexible work atmosphere.

- The chance to pioneer AI integration within our company and work on technically challenging projects.

- Opportunities for personal growth, skill advancement, and taking on leadership within the team.

- A salary between $500 and $1000, depending on your experience and abilities. (Note: as discussed, higher compensation is available for successfully leading the AI integration).

- Potential for increased earnings based on performance and results.



If you’re enthusiastic about merging AI with traditional development, structuring complex platforms, and taking ownership of your work, we’re excited to see your portfolio. To show you’ve read this job posting, please reply with the word “banana.”



Let’s build something great together!

title: Digital Agency Project Manager
description:
### About the Role ###



We are a fast-moving digital marketing agency that builds and launches sales funnels, ad campaigns, and client deliverables at pace. We are hiring a Project Manager who will own our launch calendar, run our project management tool (Basecamp), and be the single person responsible for making sure every project ships on time — every time.



This is not a coordination role. This is an enforcement role. You will be the person who holds the team accountable, including contractors, staff, and the founder. If something is late, it is your problem to solve. If someone is a blocker, you name it and escalate immediately. If scope is creeping, you kill it.



If you are the type of person who sends polite follow-up messages and waits to be chased — this role is not for you.



### What You Will Own ###



**Launch Execution**

- Own the end-to-end launch timeline for every funnel and campaign project from kickoff to go-live

- Set a hard launch date at the start of every project and work backwards to assign every task, dependency, and deadline

- Enforce a one-working-week launch window from final approval to go-live — no exceptions without your sign-off

- Run daily check-ins on all active projects to surface blockers before they become delays



**Task Assignment and Briefing**

- Every task that leaves your hands is complete — the brief, assets, references, acceptance criteria, and deadline are attached before it is assigned

- No contractor should ever need to ask what is expected of them — if they are asking, that is your failure, not theirs

- Anticipate what each role needs before they ask for it and have it ready



**Basecamp Management**

- Maintain Basecamp as the single source of truth for all active projects — every task assigned, every deadline set, every update logged

- No task sits unassigned or without a due date

- Any overdue task is flagged within 24 hours and escalated if unresolved within 48 hours



**Team Accountability**

- Chase contractors and staff for deliverables without being asked — you do not wait for people to update you

- Escalate directly to the founder when a tea
mber is consistently missing deadlines or blocking progress

- Hold a weekly project review with the founder covering what launched, what is at risk, and what needs a decision



**Process Building**

- Document what worked after each launch and turn it into a repeatable checklist for the next project

- Identify recurring bottlenecks and fix them — you are expected to make the system better over time, not just run it

- Enforce scope freeze once a project enters its final launch week — no new additions without a formal scope change



### What We Are Looking For ###



**Non-negotiable:**

- Minimum 2 years of project management experience inside a digital marketing, creative, or performance agency — not adjacent to agency work, inside it

- You have personally managed launches involving copywriters, designers, media buyers, and developers simultaneously

- You write airtight briefs — people who receive your assignments do not need to follow up for clarification

- You are comfortable telling someone senior — including the founder — that they are the bottleneck, and you do it without drama

- Fluent written and spoken English



**Strong advantage:**

- Hands-on experience with Basecamp

- Familiarity with funnel builds, landing pages, or digital campaign workflows

- Experience managing remote or contractor-heavy teams

- You have built SOPs in a fast-changing environment where the process was still being figured out



### What You Are Not ###



- You are not an account manager — you do not manage client relationships

- You are not a task logger — you do not just update Basecamp, you enforce it

- You are not a yes-person — your job is to protect the launch date and the quality of every brief that goes out, not to make everyone comfortable



### The Interview Process ###



How to Apply

Step 1: Apply via our application form here: Application Form ? 

Step 2: Upon submission, you will receive an
 with a written assessment. Read the instructions carefully and follow them exactly — this is the first test.

The assessment requires you to complete 4 scenario-based questions, track your time, and submit your completed document. Candidates who do not follow the instructions will not be reviewed.



### Summary ###



Our funnels are launching late — not because the team can't execute, but because the way work gets assigned and managed is broken. Tasks go out incomplete. Contractors spend more time asking for clarification than doing the work. Assignments come in late and the launch window shrinks before anyone has started.



We need someone who is meticulous to the point of obsession. Someone who cannot hand off a task without every brief, asset, and dependency already attached. Someone who reads a project plan and immediately spots the gap that everyone else missed. Someone who treats a missing deadline the same way others treat a fire alarm.



If you are the kind of person who has a system for everything, gets irritated when processes are sloppy, and takes it personally when a project ships late — this role was built for you.



*We move fast and the process changes as we learn. You will be building the system while running it. If that sounds like chaos to you, this is not the right role. If that sounds like exactly the problem you want to own — apply.*

title: Book Layout Artist (Full-Time)
description:
Book Layout Artist (Full-Time)

Join Our Creative Team

Your responsibilities will include:



Designing professional interior book layouts from concept through to completion.

Working from existing brand templates while also creating new layouts from scratch.

Designing layouts for books, journals, planners, workbooks, children's books, colouring books, tarot guidebooks, packaging inserts, catalogues, and other printed publications.

Applying strong typography, spacing, hierarchy, and page composition principles.

Preparing final artwork ready for production.

Applicants should be proficient in the Adobe Creative Suite, including:

Adobe Photoshop

Adobe Acrobat

Essential Skills



We're looking for someone with:



Demonstrated experience designing book interiors and publication layouts

Excellent typography and page composition skills

Strong understanding of editorial design principles

Experience working with long documents

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to organise complex documents efficiently

Strong communication skills

Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining high quality

A genuine passion for creating polished, professional printed products

Bonus Skills



While not essential, experience in the following will be highly regarded:

Preparing print-ready files for professional printing

title: Immediate Hiring! Onboarding Accountant (only for Manila Based Candidates)
description:
Location: Remote

Hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Day Shift) | Weekends Off

Reports To: Operations Manager / Client Services Manager



About Solve Outsource



At Solve Outsource, we help ambitious businesses achieve growth by providing outsourced Accounting, Bookkeeping, Payroll, and Management Accounting services.



As our client portfolio continues to expand, we're looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Onboarding Accountant to join our growing team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring new clients experience a smooth, professional transition to Solve Outsource and are set up for long-term success.



If you enjoy problem-solving, working with diverse businesses, and making a direct impact from day one, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role



The Onboarding Accountant is responsible for managing the end-to-end financial onboarding process for new clients. You will work closely with clients, previous accountants or bookkeepers, and internal stakeholders to ensure accounting records are accurate, reconciled, and ready for transition to our ongoing service delivery team.



You will serve as the bridge between a client's previous accounting function and their new outsourced finance department with Solve Outsource.



Key Responsibilities:



Manage client onboarding projects from commencement through completion.

Review accounting records and assess the current state of client accounts.

Complete catch-up bookkeeping and accounting work when required.

Reconcile bank accounts, debtors, creditors, VAT, payroll, and balance sheet accounts.

Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies, errors, and historical issues.

Liaise with clients and third parties to obtain required information and documentation.

Support accounting software migrations and data transfers.

Work across cloud accounting platforms including Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and other industry-specific systems.

Ensure onboarding procedures, documentation, and checklists are completed accurately and on time.

Prepare detailed handover notes for the ongoing client service team.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding processes and best practices.

Build strong client relationships and create an outstanding first impression of Solve Outsource.



Skills & Experience



Essential Requirements



Must be a  CPA

Must have 3-5 years related experience in Accounting and leading a team

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, management accounting, and financial controls.

Experience using accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, and/or Sage.

Excellent reconciliation and analytical problem-solving skills.

High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Strong organizational and time management abilities.

Ability to manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.



What Makes This Role Different?



This is not a traditional bookkeeping or accounting position.

Every client is different. Every onboarding project brings new systems, industries, challenges, and opportunities to learn.

One week you could be onboarding a hospitality business, the next a construction company, wholesale distributor, golf club, or professional services firm.



This role is perfect for someone who:



Enjoys variety rather than repetitive processing work.

Loves solving problems and untangling accounting issues.

Takes pride in delivering accurate and complete financial records.

Enjoys learning new technologies and accounting systems.

Wants exposure to a wide range of industries and business models.

Thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization.



Why Join Solve Outsource?

Work with a growing and ambitious outsourced finance business.

Gain exposure to diverse industries and accounting systems.

Develop both technical accounting and client-facing skills.

Join a supportive, collaborative, and high-performing team.

Enjoy genuine career progression opportunities as the company grows.

Make a meaningful impact on client success from day one.



Apply now and send your most updated resume

title: Recruitment Consultant - Work from Home + High Earnings
description:
ARE YOU A WORLD-CLASS RECRUITER WHO WANTS TO WORK FROM HOME & EARN GREAT $$$





This is an amazing opportunity to work from home and earn great money - way above the industry average through great commissions and incentives. 

  

We are a Recruitment Agency in Australia/NZ with big dreams, a solid vision, and a track record of success, and we would love to have interesting, loyal, and hard-working people come along on the journey to success. At the 
nt, we recruit in the most exciting niche ever - ACCOUNTANTS (they're not that bad...really!) in Australia and NZ and will be expanding across the world. With the right people who are hungry and want to grow, we can build teams under you and grow quite rapidly, expanding to other countries, including the US, Canada, Singapore, and other parts of the Asia Region.

  

Due to high demand in the current market, we are looking for talented and experienced 360 Agency Recruiters in South Africa to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a very dynamic role and will suit someone who is curious, has a very strong work ethic, is hungry for success, is super honest, and loves helping people succeed in their careers.

  

You will run your own desk and play an integral part in identifying and attracting the best talent in the market and providing exceptional candidates to our clients.

  

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

- Dealing with clients and candidates (cold/warm calling clients and candidates)

- Talent sourcing of prospective candidates from websites, LinkedIn, internal databases, and market mapping

- Interviewing candidates, formatting resumes, writing up summaries for clients, and doing reference checks

- Develop the right sourcing strategy to fulfil the open positions

- Plan and execute targeted talent Nurturing Programs

- Attend to general inquiries, screen and shortlist potential candidates

- Keeping regular contact with current and prospective talent and following up for future positions

- Understand trends in the marketplace and industry that present recruiting opportunities for the business

- Update CRM and databases

- Daily/Weekly recruitment progress reporting



Are you our ideal candidate? YOU DEFINITELY ARE if you have the following attributes:

- Have a minimum of 2+ years of experience recruiting in an agency environment, working with Western candidates and clients (US/AU/NZ/CA/UK/UAE/SG) - ideally in the white-collar space - where you proven experiences that can be corroborated by your manager that you can pick up the phone and cold call hundreds of clients and/or candidates

- Prepared to work hard, enjoy life while making great money

- Very success-driven and goal-oriented - we want a culture of success, and we are only prepared to hire hungry, self-driven winners

- You know how to build rapport and consult in an honest and engaging way that adds value

- Have a high level of Attention to Detail & Very Organised & Very Conscientious/Disciplined

- Must have a track record of success in your life and ability to execute and get $##t done no matter what

- Genuinely want to be involved in building the business and make it better every year - proactive individuals who strive for personal improvement

- Loyal & Intelligent - we want people who will be the fabric of this organisation for many years to come, and if you want to be involved in the management of the company, then even better. Recruitment is not something you give a go, unless you’re prepared to put in the hard yards and make it a career for at least 3-5 years – don’t bother applying – it’s too hard of a job to just “give it a go”, nor am I interested in crackheads “giving it a crack”

- Open-minded, tough, very intelligent, extremely resilient, curious and lots of fun

- People with high commercial acumen who know how to consult, not just hard sell.

- Ability to create quick and strong rapport with clients over the phone and a willingness to contribute as part of a collaborative and dynamic team

- If you have an Accounting, B2B, or Corporate background, even better. 

- You have experience using your outstanding communication skills to build strong relationships and achieve sales targets, and you are very comfortable picking up the phone for strangers!

- Excellent communication skills with fluency in the English language (10/10) - written and speaking!

- Available for at least 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday Australian/NZ/US/Asia Hours), and you understand that agency recruitment is not a 9-5 role. 

- Have your own Desktop/Laptop/Monitor with access to reliable and high-speed internet

- Can do attitude and result-driven

- Ability to work autonomously and with minimal supervision

- Over and above that, we value people who are loyal and with high integrity. Being trustworthy is the highest priority for us. If you lie to us even once, even a white-lie, you’re out!

- Excellent computer literacy skills and proficiency in sourcing tools like LinkedIn, Boolean, and Job boards and proven AI skills

  

What we found from having hired and trained many recruiters in the past, this role WILL NOT WORK for you if: 

- You DON’T have solid corporate experience (i.e.: you’ve never worked in an office environment).

- You DON’T have a stable job history (i.e.: your CV looks worse than that of a job-hopping kangaroo). Btw: stable means at least 3-5+ years in most roles.

- You're AFRAID of working hard continuously - the role requires discipline and hard work to begin with, afterwards gets much easier, you will be doing long hours, your candidates are sometimes only available after hours, so you need to be available when they are.

- You're AFRAID of picking up the phone and speaking to strangers on a daily basis and using your skills and intelligence to influence them

- You're NOT WILLING TO COMMIT 3-5 years to this because this role takes time to master and pays growing dividends the longer you're in it

- You are NOT COACHABLE & INTELLIGENT - there is a lot of training provided, so you need to want to learn and, more importantly, implement

- You're NOT A TEAM PLAYER - this is a team effort and will require everyone to contribute to the success of the business

- You are NOT COMMITTED TO YOUR SUCCESS, LACK DRIVE IN LIFE (people in the same role for 10 years do not excite me, I want to see growth), and if you HAVE OTHER BUSINESSES OR PRIORITIES on the side that will distract you - won’t work - just trust me 

- You are NOT AN HONEST & TRUSTWORTHY INDIVIDUAL - you will get full transparency, honesty, and integrity fro
 with a lot of support and training - but I expect honesty and integrity from you as well

- You are a VERY SOCIAL person who needs people physically around them all the time for banter and camaraderie - because you will struggle to work from home.

Reports To: Operations Manager / Client Services Manager



About Solve Outsource



At Solve Outsource, we help ambitious businesses achieve growth by providing outsourced Accounting, Bookkeeping, Payroll, and Management Accounting services.



As our client portfolio continues to expand, we're looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Onboarding Accountant to join our growing team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring new clients experience a smooth, professional transition to Solve Outsource and are set up for long-term success.



If you enjoy problem-solving, working with diverse businesses, and making a direct impact from day one, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role



The Onboarding Accountant is responsible for managing the end-to-end financial onboarding process for new clients. You will work closely with clients, previous accountants or bookkeepers, and internal stakeholders to ensure accounting records are accurate, reconciled, and ready for transition to our ongoing service delivery team.



You will serve as the bridge between a client's previous accounting function and their new outsourced finance department with Solve Outsource.



Key Responsibilities:



Manage client onboarding projects from commencement through completion.

Review accounting records and assess the current state of client accounts.

Complete catch-up bookkeeping and accounting work when required.

Reconcile bank accounts, debtors, creditors, VAT, payroll, and balance sheet accounts.

Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies, errors, and historical issues.

Liaise with clients and third parties to obtain required information and documentation.

Support accounting software migrations and data transfers.

Work across cloud accounting platforms including Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and other industry-specific systems.

Ensure onboarding procedures, documentation, and checklists are completed accurately and on time.

Prepare detailed handover notes for the ongoing client service team.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding processes and best practices.

Build strong client relationships and create an outstanding first impression of Solve Outsource.



Skills & Experience



Essential Requirements



Must be a  CPA

Must have 3-5 years related experience in Accounting and leading a team

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, management accounting, and financial controls.

Experience using accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, and/or Sage.

Excellent reconciliation and analytical problem-solving skills.

High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Strong organizational and time management abilities.

Ability to manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.



What Makes This Role Different?



This is not a traditional bookkeeping or accounting position.

Every client is different. Every onboarding project brings new systems, industries, challenges, and opportunities to learn.

One week you could be onboarding a hospitality business, the next a construction company, wholesale distributor, golf club, or professional services firm.



This role is perfect for someone who:



Enjoys variety rather than repetitive processing work.

Loves solving problems and untangling accounting issues.

Takes pride in delivering accurate and complete financial records.

Enjoys learning new technologies and accounting systems.

Wants exposure to a wide range of industries and business models.

Thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization.



Why Join Solve Outsource?

Work with a growing and ambitious outsourced finance business.

Gain exposure to diverse industries and accounting systems.

Develop both technical accounting and client-facing skills.

Join a supportive, collaborative, and high-performing team.

Enjoy genuine career progression opportunities as the company grows.

Make a meaningful impact on client success from day one.

title: **High-Precision Futures Trading Algorithm Developer (Look Back Strategy | NY Session | Advanced Smart Money Concepts)**
description:
Looking for a developer to build a high-precision futures trading algorithm based on a Look Back strategy using 15-minute historical candles.

The system must identify the closest valid Look Back zone, define wick/body-based entries, and execute mainly through limit orders.



Trades are allowed only during the 9:30–10:00 AM New York session.



It also requires 1-minute trade management, daily trade limits, automatic stop rules, and accurate backtesting.



Build difficulty: high — this requires precise time-based logic, multi-symbol comparison, market-structure understanding, and strong backtesting experience.

title: Finance Manager – Working Capital & AR
description:
We're an established Australian wholesale and distribution business based in Melbourne. We're growing steadily and looking for a sharp, reliable finance professional to take ownership of our accounts receivable, cash flow, and working capital.



This isn't a bookkeeping role. We already have the transactional side covered. We need someone who can think about cash. Where it's tied up, how to release it faster, and how to make our finance operations run cleanly.



The role: 



You'll own the cash side of our business. Specifically:



Accounts receivable & collections





Manage the debtor ledger end-to-end in Xero

Proactively follow up outstanding invoices via
 and phone

Build and maintain strong working relationships with our customers' AP teams

Escalate genuinely problematic debtors with a clear recommendation

Report weekly on aged receivables, DSO, and collection performance





Cash flow management





Maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast

Flag issues early. Don't wait for problems to become crises

Track variances between forecast and actual and explain the drivers





Working capital & trade finance:





Manage our debtor finance / invoice finance facility (drawdowns, reconciliations, reporting to the financier)

Support trade finance arrangements with suppliers

Identify opportunities to reduce our cash conversion cycle - inventory, payables, receivables





Systems & process improvement:





Improve how Xero integrates with our other systems (inventory, CRM, payment platforms)

Automate manual reconciliation and reporting where sensible

Document processes as you build them



About you



Must-haves





5+ years' experience in AR, credit control, or finance operations for businesses billing in AUD, USD, or GBP

Strong hands-on Xero experience (please tell us specifically what you've done in Xero)

Excellent written and spoken English, you'll be
ing and phoning Australian customers directly

Comfortable, professional, and firm when chasing overdue payments

Solid Excel / Google Sheets (formulas, pivots, basic modelling, not just data entry)

Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for customer calls





Nice to have





Accounting degree or CPA (Philippines)

Experience with invoice finance / debtor finance facilities (e.g. Octet, Waddle, Marketlend, Timelio, or similar)

Wholesale, distribution, or importing industry background

Experience integrating Xero with inventory or CRM platforms (Cin7, Unleashed, Dear, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)

Prior experience working directly with Australian businesses





What we offer



13th month pay in December

Paid Philippine public holidays

Clear pathway to full-time within 6–12 months, with a salary increase at that point

Genuine ownership of a function. You're not one of ten people doing the same thing

Direct access to the owner. Decisions get made quickly

Long-term role. We're building a team, not filling a short-term gap





How to apply



Please send:





A short cover note (5–10 sentences) telling us why this role suits you specifically. Generic applications will be skipped

Your CV



A 3–5 sentence answer to this question:

Our 13-week cash flow forecast shows a $80,000 shortfall in week 6. What are the first three things you'd look at, and what levers would you consider pulling?"





We'll invite strong applicants to a paid trial task, followed by a video interview with the General Manager. 



Thank you, we read every application.

title: Shopify Product Uploader
description:
We are looking for a dedicated and methodical Shopify Product Uploader to take ownership of listing new products on our Shopify store. This role involves precise data entry, meticulous image management, and strict adherence to established best practices. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and understand the importance of consistent, structured data in an Shopify environment.



Key Responsibilities

Working directly with us you will be provided with product data/assets, the Virtual Assistant will:



Product Data Preparation: Review and organise all provided product information (names, descriptions, pricing, SKUs, barcodes, inventory, variants like Colour/Size/Width) to ensure readiness for upload.



Media Management: Upload high-quality product images and videos, ensuring all required angles (hero shots, left/right angle, top-down, outsole, lifestyle, detail) are present and correctly attributed. Add accurate and descriptive Alt Text for all media.



Shopify Product Creation: Accurately input all core product details into the Shopify admin, including titles, descriptions, pricing, and vendor information.



Variant Configuration: Precisely set up product variants (e.g., Colour, Size, Width) with unique SKUs, correct pricing, and accurate inventory levels for each variant, assigning stock to correct locations.



Organisation & Tagging: Assign products to appropriate collections and apply consistent tags according to our governed taxonomy, facilitating easy filtering and automated processes.



Metafield Entry: Input structured product data into predefined Shopify Metafields (e.g., drop type, width fitting, technology features) as required.



SEO Optimisation: Customise page titles, meta descriptions, and URL handles for optimal search engine visibility, ensuring compliance with Google's structured data requirements for product schema.



Quality Assurance: Conduct pre-publishing reviews, including mobile previews, to verify accuracy of all details, image display, collection assignments, and inventory allocation before making products live.



Communication: Proactively communicate any discrepancies, missing data, or questions identified during the upload process.



Required Skills & Experience

Proven experience with Shopify admin panel, specifically product uploading and management.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and content population.

Strong organisational skills and ability to follow detailed instructions 

Experience with image management, including basic understanding of image dimensions and file types for web.

Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace.

Proficiency with spreadsheet software (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets) for data preparation.

Basic understanding of e-commerce best practices, particularly regarding product presentation and SEO.

Excellent written communication skills in English.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with detailed product variants (e.g., apparel, footwear).

Familiarity with structured data principles and Metafields in Shopify.

Experience with bulk upload tools like Matrixify is a bonus, but not required as primary focus will be careful manual entry.

title: Elite Video Editor (Fitness & Anime Branding)
description:
About the Channel



This is one of the longest-running fitness channels on YouTube. Eleven years in. We blend Dragon Ball Z mythology with real-world training, identity transformation, and modern fatherhood. Our audience is not here for another shredded-abs channel. They are here to become the strongest, most present version of themselves. They come for the energy. They stay for the transformation.



This is not a role for a generalist editor. This is for someone who trains, breathes anime, and is obsessed with the craft of stopping the scroll.



If that sounds like a job description you were born to write, keep reading.



Who You Are



You are an editor, but more importantly you are a fan of the culture we build content in. You watched Dragon Ball as a kid. You still get chills from the Super Saiyan Blue transformation. You lift, or you have lifted, and you know what it feels like to grind toward a body you can be proud of. You can name three anime scenes off the top of your head that would emotionally hit a 38-year-old dad watching a training vlog at 6am.



If you had to Google what a Kamehameha is, this is not the role for you.



What You'll Be Editing



Long-form YouTube videos (6-10 minutes): vlogs, training breakdowns, transformation stories, motivation

Short-form: YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels cut from the long-form

Client transformation spotlights and social proof content

Anime-infused identity content built around fatherhood, training, and character progression

Hard Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



Deep Dragon Ball Z knowledge. Arcs, characters, power levels, transformations, iconic 
nts, the emotional through-line. Not optional. If you can't tell me the difference between Ultra Instinct and Super Saiyan Blue, this role is not for you.

Broad anime literacy. One Piece, Naruto, Jujutsu Kaisen, Attack on Titan, Solo Leveling, and beyond. You should be able to pull a 
nt from any of them when the story calls for it.

Real fitness understanding. You know training principles, body transformation, nutrition basics, and gym culture. If you have never been in that world, you will not be able to edit the emotional beats of a transformation story properly.

Professional-level skill in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. Motion graphics work in After Effects or CapCut is a bonus.

Expert at pacing, jump cuts, music sync, and retention. You know the first 3 seconds d
 whether a viewer stays. You edit accordingly.

Clear English communication and reliable deadlines. You raise flags before they become problems. You do not go silent when things get hard.

Reliable internet and a computer that handles 4K footage. Non-negotiable for the delivery pace this role requires.

What Makes You Stand Out



Motion graphics, anime-style transitions, custom After Effects work, cinematic color grading, sound design and SFX, DBZ power-up effects, thumbnail creation, YouTube SEO awareness, short-form viral instincts.



Bonus points: if you personally train, have your own transformation story, or run your own content. We value editors who live the brand, not just work in it.



What the BEST Editor for This Role Looks Like



You know the first 3 seconds either win or lose the viewer. You edit like retention is a life-or-death metric, because it is.

You use DBZ power-up sequences, transformations, and iconic music as storytelling tools, not sprinkled decoration.

You can take a raw training vlog and turn it into a cinematic Saiyan-style origin story.

You study what is going viral on YouTube Shorts, Reels, and TikTok every single week.

You obsess over retention and understand the gap between a video that gets clicked and one that gets finished.

You bring ideas, not just execution.

Work Structure



100% remote, work from anywhere

Full-time preferred, part-time considered based on portfolio strength

1 to 1.5 long-form videos per week (4 to 6 per month), with thumbnails

Consistent weekly cadence with real deadlines

Direct collaboration with the channel owner via WhatsApp and Google Drive

Notion calendar for scheduling and status tracking

Sunday night status update in Notion is a hard requirement

Trial Structure



First 3 videos are your paid trial, paid per video on delivery and approval

No monthly upfront payments during the trial. This protects both of us.

After 3 clean deliveries, we move to the monthly rate

Pay



Starting at $800/month scaling to $1,200 based on experience and performance

Paid in USD via Wise

Music, sponsor logos, and brand assets are provided from the channel's own Epidemic Sound and Monstercat accounts. You will use ours, not your own.

Deal Breakers (Save Us Both Time)



Do NOT apply if:



You've never watched a full DBZ arc from start to finish

You've never lifted or been engaged with fitness culture

You need to be micro-managed on creative direction

You go silent when workloads get heavy

You've never touched anime overlays on live footage

How to Apply



Send your application
 with:



Subject line: SAIYAN EDITOR - [Your Name] - ASCEND



Applications missing "SAIYAN EDITOR" or the code word "ASCEND" in the subject line will not be reviewed. This is the first proof that you read the ad fully.



Your application
 must include:



Links to 2 to 3 samples of your video editing work (YouTube, Google Drive, or Vimeo)

A short paragraph on why you are the right editor for THIS channel. Be specific, reference the style of channel we're describing, don't send a generic pitch

Your software stack including plugins and tools

Available hours per week and your time zone

Your answers to the two questions below

Test Questions (Required)



Question 1 (Creative Fit):



Goku has reached Ultra Instinct. In the world of a 38-year-old dad who is finally training seriously for the first time in a decade, what does Ultra Instinct represent in his training journey? Now describe the exact editing beats you would use to show that 
nt in a YouTube video. I want specific cuts, sound design choices, VFX 
nts, and music sync ideas. Not a general answer. Show me you think in beats, not concepts.



Question 2 (Read-Through Check):



In one sentence, tell me the name of the platform we use for scheduling and status tracking, the number of long-form videos per week we are hiring for, and the payment platform we use to send USD. This confirms you read the full ad.



Applications missing either question will not be reviewed.
