title: Senior Amazon PPC and Listing Optimisation Strategist
description:
About Us



We are an established e-commerce business operating and growing brands on Amazon.



We have built strong internal capabilities across Amazon operations, advertising, listing optimisation, inventory management, and product launches. We are now looking for a senior Amazon specialist who can help us move beyond our current execution ceiling.



This is not a routine Amazon PPC management role.



We are looking to hire someone with deeper expertise, sharper commercial judgment, and exposure to newer tools, systems, and strategies that can bring our business to the next level.



The right person should be able to identify opportunities, risks, and knowledge gaps that our existing team may not yet recognise.



About the Role



You will take strategic ownership of Amazon PPC performance and listing optimisation across our portfolio.



Your responsibility is not simply to maintain campaigns or follow existing processes. You will be expected to assess our current approach, challenge assumptions, introduce stronger methodologies, and build a more advanced system for profitable growth.



You will work closely with the business owner and existing ecommerce team to strengthen our advertising and listing strategy.



Key Responsibilities



Amazon PPC Strategy

- Audit our existing Amazon advertising structure and identify major performance gaps

- Develop portfolio level PPC strategies across multiple products and ASINs

- Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant Amazon advertising formats

- Evaluate campaign performance beyond ACOS by considering TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

- Identify where advertising spend is creating waste, supporting organic ranking, defending the brand, acquiring customers, or accelerating product growth

- Improve keyword harvesting, search term management, campaign segmentation, bid management, budget allocation, and placement optimisation

- Establish clear campaign objectives based on the strategic role of each ASIN

- Build systems to monitor and optimise both high volume products and long tail products

- Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision making, efficiency, and performance

- Provide clear recommendations that translate data into business actions



Listing Optimisation

- Conduct detailed listing audits covering keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

- Improve product titles, bullet points, descriptions, search terms, images, and A Plus Content recommendations

- Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

- Develop testing plans for listing elements and measure the commercial impact of changes

- Work with copywriters and designers to produce stronger listing assets

- Ensure that listing optimisation and PPC strategy support one another



Systems and Leadership

- Build stronger frameworks, scorecards, dashboards, and operating procedures for Amazon advertising and listing optimisation

- Train and upskill existing tea
mbers

- Explain complex findings clearly to management and recommend priorities

- Identify areas where our existing processes, tools, or assumptions may be limiting growth

- Take ownership of execution without requiring constant direction or close supervision

- Keep the company updated on important developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and ecommerce technology



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



- At least five years of strong Amazon marketplace experience

- Advanced hands on experience managing Amazon PPC for established brands or large product portfolios

- Demonstrated success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and advertising efficiency

- Strong expertise in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

- Experience working with accounts that have multiple ASINs and complex campaign structures

- Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, inventory, and return on advertising investment

- Experience using advanced Amazon advertising and analytics tools

- Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

- The ability to identify problems and opportunities that are not immediately obvious

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong ownership, initiative, analytical thinking, and attention to detail

- Strong Advantages



It would be highly advantageous if you have experience with:



1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio level budget allocation

9. AI assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



Who Will Succeed in This Role



You will likely succeed if you are someone who:



1. Thinks beyond standard PPC metrics

2. Can distinguish between tactical improvements and strategic opportunities

3. Is comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

4. Can explain what should change, why it should change, and how it should be implemented

5. Brings structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

6. Continues learning and remains current with Amazon platform developments

7. Wants to influence business strategy rather than simply complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids, downloads reports, or follows standard operating procedures.



We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



Working days and hours:

• Full-time basis – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

• Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

• 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



Application Instructions:

Please submit your application with the following (applications without these will be less considered):

• Your CV/Resume.

• A short video introduction of yourself and why you’re a good fit.

• A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

• Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

• The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

• Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application.

title: Lead Generation Social Media Manager for Online Coach

Everyone's application ends up sounding the same when it's AI-written. Yes, even when you're on the paid version with the best prompt. Trust me, I can tell. If your content sounds like AI slop, we won't be a fit. I want a real human voice, real strategy, and real results.



This role requires you to be available during EST hours, roughly 10am-2pm. Please don't apply if you can't commit to this. It's non-negotiable.

• Build content strategies that drive measurable growth

• Chat in the DMs, nurture conversations, and move people toward a sale. You're comfortable and genuinely good at sales

• Set up and optimize lead gen campaigns, funnels, and offers

• Track metrics and adjust based on what the numbers say

• Test, iterate, and scale what works



What I'm looking for:



• A proven track record in social media lead generation

• A strategist who's also happy to roll up their sleeves and execute daily

• Someone who's great at DM conversations and knows how to move a chat toward a sale without being pushy

• Someone growth-oriented who's moved the needle before

• Strong grasp of Instagram,
, Threads, and LinkedIn

• Solid copywriting and content skills 

• Comfortable using your God given brain instead of relying on AI to do the work

• Someone looking for a stable, long-term role who wants to grow with me

• A backup internet setup and a plan for power interruptions



To apply, answer these in your application (incomplete applications will be dismissed):

title: Spotify Playlist Growth Manager – Cassidy Records
description:
We are looking for someone deeply connected to music culture, Spotify, TikTok trends, playlists, and viral internet behavior.



Our goal is to build a massive Spotify playlist network that will help support and grow our record label over time.



The vision is ambitious:

We want to create around 15 playlists per day across multiple Spotify accounts and slowly build a powerful ecosystem of playlists focused on different moods, aesthetics, genres, trends, and internet cultures.



The objective is NOT to create random playlists.



We want playlists that:



Gain real followers

Generate saves

Build repeat listeners

Reach thousands of streams organically

Eventually grow into playlists with 10,000+ listeners and beyond



We fully understand that not every playlist will succeed.

This is a long-term volume + testing strategy.



The purpose of this network is to eventually help support and promote releases from our artists and label naturally through strong playlist positioning and audience building.



Very important:

We are not pretending we already know the perfect way to achieve this.



What we are presenting here is the result we want.



That is exactly why we are looking for someone experienced who can help us figure out the best strategy, structure, and execution.



We are looking for someone who understands:



Spotify behavior

Viral music trends

TikTok culture

Playlist psychology

Audience retention

Music discovery

Organic growth systems



We do NOT want someone that simply waits for instructions.



We want someone proactive who can say:



“This is what I would test.”

“This is how I would structure the playlists.”

“This is how I would grow the network.”

“This is how I would maximize organic reach.”



When applying, please explain:



Why are you a good fit for this role?

What experience or knowledge do you have with Spotify playlists or music growth?

How would you personally approach building this playlist network?

What strategies would you test first?

How would you help us grow playlists organically over time?

What ideas would you bring to help scale this into a serious playlist ecosystem?



Bonus if you understand:



Spotify SEO

TikTok music trends

Electronic music culture

Hardstyle / Hardtekk / Techno

Viral content

Playlist branding & aesthetics



We are looking for someone creative, hungry, strategic, and long-term minded that truly believes they can help us build something big.

title: Stock Trading (Futures and US Stocks)

Develop and manage LEAPS options strategies (long-term calls/puts, spreads, etc.)

Why the trade was taken

Why alternative trades were NOT taken

Market conditions and indicators used

Deep understanding of:

Technical analysis (price action, volume, support/resistance, indicators)

Market structure and macro influences

Experience using trading platforms (e.g., Thinkorswim, TradingView, Interactive Brokers, etc.)

U.S.-based and actively trading U.S. markets

Mandatory Proof of Work (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



Applicants MUST provide:



Verified or trackable trading history / performance records

Sample trade logs or journal entries

Real examples of:

Day trades/scalps

LEAPS options setups

Explanation of at least 2–3 past trades, including full reasoning and outcomes



Applications without proof will NOT be considered.



What We’re Looking For (Key Traits)

Discipline over emotion

Data-driven decision making

High accountability and transparency

Ability to avoid overtrading and low-quality setups

Focus on quality over quantity

Compensation

Flexible: Hourly, per-trade, profit share, or performance-based structure

Open to structuring incentives based on results

How to Apply



Submit:



Resume or trading background

Verified trading results or screenshots

2–3 detailed trade breakdowns (your best work)

Brief explanation of your trading strategy and edge

Important Note



This is a performance-driven role. We are only interested in traders who can demonstrate consistent results and articulate their decision-making process at a high level.

title: Content Writer
description:
Content Writer -- Australian Safety & Compliance (Part-Time, Remote)



We run a safety and compliance blog for an Australian manufacturing business. The content covers Australian standards, workplace safety regulations, and compliance topics relevant to emergency services and industrial sectors.

We are looking for a writer who can research properly and write in a clear, authoritative style. This is not general content work. You need to be comfortable reading technical documents, Australian Standards references, and government publications, then turning that into well-structured articles that a professional audience will actually read.



What you will be doing

Writing one to two articles per month. We provide the topic. You research, write, and reference it properly using academic or university-style referencing (APA or similar).



What we are looking for

Someone who has written technical or regulatory content before. You need to be able to read an Australian Standard or compliance document and understand it well enough to write about it accurately. Strong written English is essential. AI-generated content will not be accepted.



Rate: 550 PHP per hour



Hours: Varies, roughly 4 to 8 hours per article depending on complexity



Start: Immediately



To apply, send two writing samples. At least one should be technical, regulatory, or standards-based writing. No samples, no response.

title: Watercolor Artist / Designer For Gift Wrap Patterns And Custom Crests
description:
# Watercolor Artist / Designer For Gift Wrap Patterns And Custom Crests



Maria Gossard Designs is looking for a highly talented watercolor artist/designer with experience creating elegant gift wrap patterns, custom crests, monograms, florals, botanicals, and decorative artwork for luxury paper goods.



This role is for someone with true artistic ability, refined taste, beautiful color judgment, and a strong understanding of composition, pattern, and heirloom-quality design.



We are not looking for a generic Canva designer, basic graphic designer, logo designer, or someone who only works with premade clip art. We are looking for an artist who can create original, elevated watercolor-style artwork that can be developed into gift wrap and custom crests.



## About Maria Gossard Designs



Maria Gossard Designs is a luxury design and print studio specializing in wedding invitations, custom stationery, watercolor artwork, monograms, crests, gift wrap, holiday paper goods, and meaningful event details.



Our style is refined, romantic, elegant, classic, artful, and detail-driven. We create products for clients who value beauty, craftsmanship, personalization, and heirloom-quality design.



## The Role



This role will focus primarily on two areas:



1. **Watercolor gift wrap patterns**

2. **Custom watercolor crests and monograms**



The right artist should be able to create artwork that feels polished, elegant, charming, and appropriate for a luxury stationery and gifting brand.



## Main Responsibilities



Responsibilities may include:



1. Creating original watercolor-style gift wrap patterns

2. Creating custom watercolor crests and monograms

3. Developing floral, botanical, coastal, holiday, garden, or decorative motifs

4. Creating repeat patterns for gift wrap

5. Creating coordinated artwork elements that can be used across crests, liners, tags, cards, and wrap

6. Developing refined color palettes

7. Preparing artwork for print production

8. Revising artwork based on creative direction

9. Keeping files organized and clearly labeled

10. Communicating progress clearly and professionally



## Required Skills



Please apply only if you have strong experience with:



* Watercolor-style illustration

* Gift wrap or repeat pattern design

* Custom crests or monograms

* Floral and botanical artwork

* Decorative motifs

* Elegant color palettes

* Composition and layout

* Adobe Illustrator and/or Photoshop

* Preparing artwork for print



Experience with hand-painted watercolor, Procreate, or digital watercolor illustration is a plus.



## Design Style



The artwork should feel:



* Refined

* Romantic

* Elegant

* Classic

* Heirloom-quality

* Fresh

* Beautifully composed

* Appropriate for luxury stationery and gifting



Depending on the collection, the style may include:



* English garden

* Coastal New England

* Chinoiserie

* Grandmillennial

* Classic Christmas

* Romantic wedding

* Botanical

* Preppy and polished

* Soft baby shower

* Holiday gifting



The work should never feel cheap, generic, overly cartoonish, mass-market, poorly composed, AI produced or clip-art based.



## Important Requirements



All artwork must be original or properly licensed.



No stolen artwork, copied designs, trademarked characters, copyrighted imagery, or unlicensed assets may be used.



All assigned work must be completed personally by you. No outsourcing, no sharing files, and no using another artist’s work as your own.



All client information, artwork concepts, brand materials, and files must remain confidential.



## What This Role Is Not



This is not a general VA role.

This is not a social media template role.

This is not a basic Canva-only design role.

This is not a logo design role.

This is not a role for someone who only uses premade clip art.

This is not a role for someone who cannot create refined, original artwork.



This role is specifically for a watercolor artist/designer who can create beautiful gift wrap patterns and custom crests for a luxury paper goods brand.



## Position Type



This will begin as project-based work, with the possibility of ongoing collaboration if the fit is strong.



## Application Instructions



Please apply with the subject line:



**Watercolor Gift Wrap Artist**



In your application, please include:



1. A brief introduction

2. Your years of experience as a watercolor artist, illustrator, or designer

3. The software or tools you use

4. A portfolio showing watercolor artwork, gift wrap patterns, repeat patterns, custom crests, monograms, florals, botanicals, or decorative artwork

5. Examples of gift wrap or repeat patterns if available

6. Examples of custom crests or monograms if available

7. Examples of floral, botanical, holiday, coastal, or garden artwork

8. Your experience preparing artwork for print

9. Your preferred hourly rate or project rate

10. Your availability for project-based work

11. Confirmation that all work is completed personally by you and not outsourced

12. Confirmation that all artwork will be original or properly licensed



## Application Questions



Please answer the following:



1. How many years of experience do you have creating watercolor-style artwork?

2. Have you created gift wrap patterns before?

3. Have you created repeat patterns for print?

4. Have you created custom crests or monograms?

5. What types of watercolor motifs do you most enjoy creating?

6. Are you comfortable creating floral, botanical, holiday, coastal, garden, or decorative artwork?

7. Are you comfortable creating artwork from inspiration images and written creative direction?

8. Are you able to create artwork that feels refined, romantic, classic, and elevated?

9. What software or tools do you use?

10. Can you prepare artwork for print production?

11. Do you personally complete all artwork yourself?

12. Do you use hand-painted watercolor, digital watercolor, AI-generated elements, licensed assets, or a combination? Please explain clearly.

13. Are you comfortable completing a small paid test project before a final decision is made?

14. Why do you think you would be a good fit for Maria Gossard Designs?



## Paid Test Project



Strong candidates may be asked to complete a small paid test project before a final decision is made.



The test may include creating a small watercolor gift wrap pattern concept, a custom crest direction, a monogram concept, or a mini collection of watercolor motifs based on a creative brief.



## Final Note



We are looking for a true watercolor artist/designer with refined taste, strong pattern sense, beautiful color judgment, and the ability to create elegant artwork for gift wrap and custom crests.



If you can create beautiful watercolor gift wrap patterns and custom crests, we would love to see your work.

mbers when directed

CRM & System Management

Build and maintain a master client and subcontractor contact database



What We're Looking For

Experience



Proven experience in an Executive Assistant or senior admin role, ideally supporting a high-volume, fast-moving business owner

CRM experience required; Salesforce experience strongly preferred given the active migration

Background in construction, restoration, property management, or trades is a strong advantage

title: Remote Quoting Assistant Gutter Guard Measurements & Quotes
description:
JOB TITLE: Remote Quoting Assistant — Gutter Measuring & Pricing



ABOUT US

We're Titan Gutter Guards, an Australian business that supplies and installs gutter protection. When a homeowner enquires, we measure their roof from aerial imagery and send them a fast, accurate quote — no need to visit the property first. We're growing quickly and looking for a reliable, detail-focused person to own this measuring-and-quoting process for us.



THE ROLE

You'll take new leads that come into our CRM, measure their gutters using aerial mapping software, work out the price with our calculator, and update everything back into the CRM so we know exactly what each job is quoted at. Full step-by-step training (videos + written SOPs) is provided — if you're accurate, organised, and good with software, we'll teach you the rest.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (DAY TO DAY)

- Check our CRM (GoHighLevel) for new leads that need measuring and pricing.

- Open each property's address in Vexcel (aerial measuring software) and carefully measure all the gutters — total linear metres, valleys, and any other runs.

- Note the key details that affect price: steep roof (yes/no), double storey (yes/no), solar panels, access.

- Enter the measurements and notes clearly into the lead in GoHighLevel.

- Work out travel distance/time from our installer base.

- Price the job using our pricing calculator (you just fill in the yellow cells — it does the maths).

- Update the price and travel cost back into GoHighLevel so every job's quoted value is recorded.

- Follow our SOPs exactly so every quote is consistent, fair, and nothing gets missed.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent attention to detail — measuring accurately is the whole job ("measure twice, quote once").

- Comfortable learning and using web software (CRM, mapping tools, Google Sheets/Docs).

- Good written English.

- Reliable internet connection and a computer capable of running mapping software smoothly.

- Consistent, self-managed, and dependable — you'll be trusted to work through leads on your own.

- Basic numeracy (you won't need advanced maths — the calculator handles it — but you should be confident with numbers).



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM.

- Experience with aerial measuring / mapping tools, quoting, estimating, or admin support.

- Any background in construction, roofing, or trades quoting.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE (ALL TRAINING PROVIDED)

GoHighLevel (CRM) · Vexcel (aerial measuring) · Google Sheets pricing calculator · Google Docs



DETAILS

- 100% remote.

- Hours: [e.g. 20 hrs/week to start, room to grow to full-time]

- Pay: [your rate]

- Long-term role for the right person — we want to hire and keep someone great.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. A short note on why you'd be good at a detail-focused measuring/quoting role.

2. Any examples or proof of similar work you've done (quoting, estimating, CRM, admin, mapping — screenshots or samples are great).

3. Your available hours and expected rate.

title: Online Events Manager
description:
Online Events Manager & Administrative Genius - Vet Education



STOP.



Before you go any further, read this. Applications are accepted by direct
 only, to 
 to detail is the whole job, so please send us exactly what we have requested under HOW TO APPLY below.



Are you an English language enthusiast with a flair for creative writing and a keen eye for grammar and spelling? Do you have a passion for technology and a track record of successfully managing busy events – be it online or physical?

If you are, VetEducation is looking for you to join our team as an Online Events Coordinator

About VetEducation



We’re more than your average veterinary CE provider - and we’re proud of that. Since 2007, VetEducation (
) has delivered premium online courses and webinars to veterinary professionals worldwide. We're here to help our community thrive with clinically relevant, engaging education - and we want to grow that mission with you on board.

Before we even start - the very first criteria is that you need to be CRAZY about animals.

We are part of the veterinary industry - so as colleagues, a deep love and respect for animals is the first thing we need to have in common.





Responsibilities and Skills Required: 



Impeccable English Communication - Non-Negotiable



This is the single most important requirement in this role. You will be communicating daily via video and
, with international veterinary clinicians, academics, and stakeholders across multiple time zones and cultures.

We need someone who thinks natively in English. You need to speak and write with natural fluency, confidence, and warmth. Your grammar, tone, and word choice should feel effortless rather than translated or AI generated.

If English is the language your brain reaches for first, we want to hear from you.

Your written and spoken English will be assessed at every stage of this application process.

Organisational Skills Under Pressure - Non-Negotiable



Online events have many moving parts- speakers, slide decks, registration links, tech checks, attendee communications, post production editing, key stakeholder communication and everything in between - done on time without exception.

We need someone with a proven track record of managing multiple concurrent projects without dropping the ball. Experience in event coordination, project management, IT project administration, or advertising production will be highly regarded.

In your cover letter to us, we want to see evidence of real systems, like checklists that you may have built you've built, workflows / systems you've created , and projects you've delivered on time when the pressure was on.

In your cover letter, please give us a specific example of a time you successfully managed multiple deadlines simultaneously. Tell us what your system looked like.

Attention to Detail - Non-Negotiable



Your role is a front facing role. hence, this is the skill that holds everything together in this role and it is also the hardest one to fake

What we mean here are things like - A wrong link in an attendee
. A speaker's name spelled inconsistently. A time zone error in a calendar invite. These are just some examples and in this role, these affect the entire flow of an event.

We need someone who catches errors before they go out. Someone who reads everything twice and who notices what shouldn't be there.

Tech Savviness: 



You will need to be well-versed in various technologies, including virtual event platforms, collaboration tools, and CMS platforms. You will be involved in video editing of the lectures that are produced and preparation of all the presentation material that is sent to you before an event. This role will require you to adapt quickly to learn and utilize new technologies effectively.

Event Coordination: 



You will be taking charge of planning, coordinating, and executing online events. To do this role efficiently and effectively, you will be managing all the moving parts that go into organising events.

You will need to be good at following existing checklists and creating your own as you see fit to create efficient workflows. Your responsibility is to ensure a seamless event and experience for all stakeholders.





Digital Partnerships:



You will collaborate with clients and digital partners to develop and nurture sponsorships and collaborations, and contribute to VetEducation's presence in the veterinary education space.

Marketing Support:



You'll work closely with our marketing team on social media engagement, content creation, and event promotion..

Initiative and Strategy:



We want someone who is proactive and displays initiative to identify opportunities for improvement, contribute to event strategies, and suggest innovative ideas to enhance the VetEducation’s digital presence.

Collaborative Team Player:



We're a small, close-knit team. Everyone chips in, everyone communicates, and everyone matters. As the company grows, this role will expand and you'll have opportunities to diversify your skill set if you choose to.





Some Additional Details:



This is a work from home position and your workday starts at 8:00 am IST. The role is full-time, 5 days a week, 40 hours a week- Mon - Fri.

Competitive compensation based on experience

A strong internet connection and your own computer is vital to this position as we communicate daily with tea
mbers and clients via video chat.

This is a busy role with a lot of international video communication between tea
mbers and clients-so we would need minimal distractions and a quiet office spaced during the time that you allocate to your role.

Reliability matters deeply to us. Unless you can wholeheartedly commit, please do not apply.



HOW TO APPLY FOR THIS ROLE: 



To apply, please send the following to Dr Charisma Judge - 

1) Your Resume and 



2) Your Cover letter - including a specific example of how you've managed multiple deadlines simultaneously, and what your system looked like. Experience in online events management or project management should be detailed here.

3) Writing samples that show us your everyday written voice. Real, dated
 correspondence is what we are after. In a world where everything is helped along by AI, what we really want to see is how you naturally word your everyday conversations and correspondence. Please send a few dated
s only, no blogs or articles. Feel free to redact anything sensitive, names,
 addresses, project names, all of that.
 communication with international clinicians and academics is a mainstay of this role, so this matters to us.

4) A short video - grab your phone and record a video selfie of yourself - tell us three things in your own words 1) who you are, 2) why you think you'd be great at this role, and 3) something that made you genuinely laugh recently at work or in life. Please keep it natural and keep it you.

title: Expert AI Video Editor & Social Content Creator
description:
# Part-Time AI Video Editor & Social Content Creator



## About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled, visually creative AI Video Editor and Social Content Creator based in the Philippines.



This is not an entry-level video-editing position. We need someone who is already experienced with AI-generated video, AI image editing, product replacement, background replacement and short-form social advertising.



You will work with existing product photography, raw video footage, creator content and creative direction to produce polished content for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other digital platforms.



This is a remote, part-time position with the potential to grow into a larger long-term role.



## Responsibilities



* Edit short-form advertisements and organic social-media videos

* Create multiple hooks, openings and variations from existing footage

* Use AI to replace or modify backgrounds, locations, environments and objects

* Replace products in videos and photographs while maintaining realistic lighting, perspective, scale and shadows

* Place our products naturally into existing photographs and video scenes

* Turn still images into realistic video sequences

* Generate supplemental footage when the required shot does not exist

* Remove unwanted objects, people, logos and visual distractions

* Retouch and enhance product, lifestyle and creator photography

* Resize and reformat content for different social-media platforms

* Add captions, voiceovers, music, sound effects, transitions and motion graphics

* Create realistic AI-generated lifestyle, product and advertising imagery

* Maintain accurate product packaging, labels, proportions, colors and branding

* Organize project files and deliver finished assets according to deadlines

* Stay current with rapidly changing AI video and image-generation platforms

* Collaborate with our marketing team to improve creative performance



## Required Software Experience



Applicants must have strong professional experience with:



* Runway

* CapCut Pro

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe After Effects or an equivalent motion-graphics platform



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:



* Kling AI

* Google Veo

* Seedance

* Sora

* Midjourney

* Adobe Firefly

* Flux

* ComfyUI

* Nano Banana

* Topaz Video AI

* Topaz Photo AI

* ElevenLabs

* HeyGen

* Descript



You do not need to use every platform listed above. However, you must be able to select the right software for each project rather than relying on one AI tool for everything.



## Required Qualifications



* A strong portfolio of AI-generated and traditionally edited content

* Proven experience editing short-form social-media advertisements

* Advanced understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and platform-native editing

* Strong photo-editing and image-compositing abilities

* Ability to make AI-generated content look realistic rather than obviously artificial

* Excellent attention to product labels, packaging and brand consistency

* Strong sense of composition, lighting, typography, color and visual storytelling

* Ability to follow detailed creative direction

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

* Strong written and spoken English

* Reliable computer, high-speed internet and file-management system



Experience with beauty, personal care, wellness, fashion, outdoor or consumer-product brands is highly desirable.



## What We Are Not Looking For



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to trim footage, add subtitles or apply CapCut templates.



We need a creative problem-solver who understands both traditional post-production and modern generative-AI workflows.



## Schedule



* Part-time remote position

* Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially

* Some overlap with U.S. business hours may occasionally be required

* Hours may increase based on performance and creative volume



## Compensation



$15–$20 USD per hour, depending on portfolio quality, experience, speed and technical ability.



Exceptional candidates with advanced AI compositing, motion graphics or performance-ad experience may be considered at a higher rate.



## Application Requirements



Please include:



1. A short introduction describing your AI video and image-editing experience

2. A link to your portfolio

3. Three examples of your strongest short-form social videos

4. Examples showing AI background replacement, product replacement or realistic image-to-video work

5. A list of the AI and editing platforms you use professionally

6. Your requested hourly rate

7. Your weekly availability

8. Your computer specifications and internet speed



Please begin your application with the words “ALPINE AI” so we know you read the complete job description.



## Paid Skills Test



Finalists will be invited to complete a paid creative test using supplied product assets and footage.



The test may include:



* Editing one short-form social advertisement

* Creating three different opening hooks

* Replacing or modifying a background

* Integrating a product naturally into an image or video

* Producing one AI-generated product or lifestyle image



The test will be evaluated based on realism, creativity, product accuracy, editing quality, speed and ability to follow creative direction.

description:

, Airbnb)

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Please read out short description in full. Or you'll miss important detail. 



We're a new company to fashion industry in the USA which brings herritage European designs with a modern touch of convenience. 



We're hiring one person to drive growth across both sides of the business: closing wholesale relationships and managing our retail presence, while also owning the social and content voice that brings our DTC brand to life.



Please start your cover letter with "I speak perfect English". That needs to be true and also shows us that you read the post. All other appicants will be ignored. 



This is a hybrid sales-and-marketing seat, split roughly evenly between two functions:



B2B Sales & Outreach (~50%)



Directly contact boutiques, independent retailers, and resellers to pitch wholesale partnerships (we have a list). 

Manage the full outreach cycle: prospecting, cold
/DM outreach, follow-up, negotiation, onboarding.

Maintain a pipeline of leads and partner accounts (CRM or structured tracker).

Represent the brand professionally in every external communication — tone and polish matter.

Support marketplace account management as we expand to wholesale platforms.



B2C Marketing & Content (~50%)

Plan and execute social media (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest) — content calendar, captions, community engagement, trend awareness

Write and optimize product listings and on-site copy for our Shopify store, with SEO best practices for luxury/fashion search intent

Stay current on retail and fashion e-commerce trends and suggest campaigns, collabs, or content formats that fit our brand voice

Collaborate with the founder on launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand storytelling





What We're Looking For



Fluent, polished English — written and spoken. This is non-negotiable: you'll be writing customer-facing copy and pitching real business partners. Native English not required if your fluency is excellent.

Proven e-commerce and/or sales experience — outreach, account management, or DTC marketing background. Direct fashion/luxury experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.

Social media fluency — you understand platform-specific content (not just posting the same thing everywhere) and can speak to current trends without being told what they are.

Shopify familiarity — comfortable editing listings, understanding storefront basics; admin experience preferred.

SEO literacy — understands on-page SEO for product and content pages, especially how it applies to fashion/luxury search behavior (keyword intent, descriptive copy that still converts).

Self-directed — this is a founder-led startup; you'll need to work independently, propose ideas, and manage your own pipeline without heavy oversight.

Comfortable with both cold outreach and creative work — the split matters. We need someone who won't burn out doing sales
s one day and content calendars the next.



Compensation will be a combination of competitive hourly rate (up to $5/hour) plus bonus based on results. 



Nice to have:





Experience with wholesale platforms (e.g., Faire) or retail marketplaces

A portfolio or examples of past social content / product copy you've written

Familiarity with CRM or outreach tools (any — we're not locked into a specific stack yet)

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Right-Hand Operator (Ground Floor) — Hot Inbound Leads Only, No Cold Calling — Build a Fence Company With Me
description:
Hi! I'm Kaleb, owner of a startup fence company in Michigan, USA. We're building a faster, smarter way for homeowners to get fence quotes — using satellite imagery and online mapping instead of the old drive-to-every-house sales process.



I'm not looking for someone to just do tasks. I'm looking for my right hand — one hungry, ambitious person who wants to get in at the ground floor and build this company with me. The person who proves themselves here doesn't stay a quoter. They become the core of my operations team, take on more, earn more, and grow as fast as the company does. If you've been waiting for a shot to prove what you can really do — this is it.



THE HONEST SETUP:

We're a startup, so I can't promise full-time hours yet, and I won't pretend otherwise. This role is performance-based — you earn at every stage as a lead moves toward a sold job (full breakdown below). The harder and smarter you work, the more you make and the faster this becomes a stable, full-time position with a monthly base. I want someone who sees that as the opportunity it is.



HERE'S WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT — AND EASY:

No cold calling. No outreach. No chasing strangers. Every lead you touch is a hot, incoming request — someone who already found us and asked for a fence quote. Most leads you won't even speak to; it's all done through the computer.



The one thing I ask: speed to lead. When a new lead comes in, you'll get an
 notification, and I need you to respond within 10 minutes. In this business, the company that answers first almost always wins the job. That's our edge, and it's your #1 responsibility. If you check your
 like a hawk and love being first to jump on an opportunity, you'll thrive here. If replying fast stresses you out, this isn't the role.



THE SETUP:

- 100% computer-based — no door-knocking, no in-person visits

- All leads are hot and inbound — no prospecting, ever

-
 notification the 
nt a lead comes in — respond within 10 minutes

- Most leads never need a phone call — it's handled online



IMPORTANT — HOURS:

Our leads come in on U.S. Eastern time (Michigan). To hit the 10-minute response, you'll need to be available during U.S. da
 hours. If you're willing to work U.S. hours, this role can grow into something big for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Study satellite and aerial images of U.S. homes — yards, driveways, garages, pools, sheds, patios, trees, and property layouts

- Identify where a fence would go based on what the customer wants

- Create accurate fence quotes using our process (I'll train you fully)

- Measure properties using online mapping tools

- Respond fast, follow up with leads, and keep customer info organized

- Take on more responsibility as fast as you can earn it



THIS IS THE CORE SKILL:

You'll spend real time looking at aerial views of American homes. You need to tell a front yard from a backyard from a side yard, spot driveways, gates, neighboring fences, pool areas, detached garages, and common obstacles — and understand where a new fence fits. No fencing experience needed, but comfort with maps and property layouts is a must. Accuracy matters — these quotes help real people make real buying decisions.



HOW YOU'LL BE PAID (PERFORMANCE-BASED):



Online leads — you earn at every stage:

- $3 for every completed, accurate quote

- +$20 when your quote leads to a booked final walk-through

- +$30 when that lead becomes a real, paying job

- A single online lead taken all the way through earns you $53



Phone support — highest-level English only:

Phone work isn't required. But if you have clear, professional, confident spoken English and want to earn more:

- $10 per qualified call handled

- $75 when a call turns into a real, paying job



Phone-capable people get first access to expanded commissions as we grow.



As we scale, the person who shows up hungry moves to a stable monthly base plus bonuses. I reward the people who build with me.



Paid in USD via Wise.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:

- Hungry and ambitious — you want to grow, earn, and build, not just clock tasks

- Fast — you respond to opportunities immediately, not "when you get to it"

- Takes ownership and figures things out without being micromanaged

- Sharp, detail-oriented, and quick to learn

- Comfortable on a computer and familiar with Google Maps, Google Earth, or similar tools

- Available during U.S. hours and wants a long-term seat in a company they helped build



TO APPLY:

Start your message with the word "FENCE" (this tells me you actually read the whole post), then tell me a bit about yourself, your experience, and why you'd be a good fit. Also answer:



1. Have you used Google Maps, Google Earth, or satellite images for work before? Tell me how.

2. Looking at a satellite image of a home, how would you tell the backyard apart from the front yard? Describe what you'd look for.

3. Are you comfortable measuring property layouts from aerial images?

4. How would you rate your spoken English (1–10), and are you open to phone work for higher pay?

5. Tell me about a time you went above and beyond what was asked of you. What did you do, and why?

6. Are you available to work U.S. Eastern hours, and how fast do you typically respond to notifications?



I read every application that starts with FENCE. I'm looking for someone special — if that's you, show me. Looking forward to meeting you!

title: Video Editor for AI Generated Video Anime
description:
AI Video Editor (Anime Style) — Micro-Project



We're looking for a highly creative, technical, and disciplined AI Video Editor to create AI generated video anime about dentistry and also transform raw educational and clinical dental footage into high-octane, dramatic anime-style content for short-form feeds. This is primarily an AI video generation role - not traditional editing or branding work - where CapCut or other editing tools are used to assemble, adjust, and stitch assets together .



Key Responsibilities

- AI Transformation: Process clinical dental footage and dramatic facial expressions (sometimes recording your own) through DomoAI, and generate anime-style cutaways using tools like NanoBanana, Veo, or Kling AI.

- Text-to-Video dental B-Roll: Generate cinematic, abstract anime cutaways using AI prompts to visually explain complex concepts using similar tools as mentioned above 

- CapCut (or other tool) Assembly: Stitch clips, add kinetic pop-up captions, apply crash zooms, impact frames, and speed ramps.

- Premium Sound Design: Source and layer intense shonen-style SFX to drive comedic and dramatic timing.

- Format videos specifically for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and
.

- Asset Management: Organise raw files, drafts, and finalised assets securely.



Required Skills

- Understand storyboard, character creation and consistency within scenes.

- Hands-on experience generating video with AI tools (DomoAI, Runway, Veo, Kling, or similar), and comfort iterating prompts quickly.

- Basic to intermediate CapCut (or other tools) skills: stitching, text overlays, pacing, exporting ad-ready formats.

- Understanding of short-form hook mechanics — why the first 3 seconds matter, why native-looking content often outperforms overly polished edits.

- Deep familiarity with anime culture, shonen tropes, and comedic pacing.

- Ability to hit tight deadlines and daily targets independently, without spoon-feeding.



Nice to Have

- Previous anime-style clip experience.

- Familiarity with creative testing/variations and UGC-style ads.



Time Commitment

A few focused hours per week (long term daily), consistent availability, long-term if output is strong.



---

1. Subject Line: *I (your first name) am ready to enter the interview room*

2. Name your top 3 anime series 

3. Links: 3–5 AI-generated video examples (anime-style or other), plus any relevant portfolio/CV.

4. Confirm the AI tools you actively use and what tools you use to edit with.

title: YouTube & Instagram Video Editor – Cinematic Health & Storytelling Content
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative YouTube Video Editor to join our content production team. You will be editing videos focused on lifestyle health, storytelling, and education, blending cinematic visuals with engaging, informative content.



Your role will be to turn raw footage, voiceovers, and B-roll into captivating episodes that keep viewers watching from start to finish, following a cohesive visual and audio structure (e.g., chapter slides, mini visual aids, cinematic transitions, and purposeful sound design).



Responsibilities:

Edit 5–10 minute YouTube videos and occasional deep-dive episodes (15–30 minutes) using our established style guide.

Incorporate on-screen text, motion graphics, and B-roll to reinforce key points.

Follow and improve our CapCut/Premiere Pro editing workflow for consistent quality and faster production.

Select and mix background music and sound effects to match pacing and emotion.

Ensure each video follows a strong storytelling arc that educates and inspires.

Collaborate closely with the content creator for feedback, revisions, and style alignment.

Keep up to date with YouTube trends, retention tactics, and audience engagement strategies.



Requirements:

Proven experience editing YouTube videos, preferably in the health, lifestyle, or educational space.

Strong skills in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro (motion graphics experience a plus).

Ability to work with cinematic visuals, chapter-based structuring, and sound design.

Understanding of YouTube best practices for retention, pacing, and engagement.

Creative mindset with strong attention to detail and storytelling.

Reliable, able to meet deadlines, and responsive to feedback.



Preferred Skills (Not Required):

Experience with MidJourney or AI-based B-roll creation.

Knowledge of social media short-form editing (Instagram Reels, TikTok).

Basic color grading and audio mixing.

title: Full-Time Secretary / Executive Assistant for US Tech Company
description:
We're a technology consultancy based in the USA. We build custom software and automation for our business clients. We're hiring a full-time secretary/executive assistant who will work directly with the founder.



This is a real long-term position, not project work. We're looking for someone who wants one stable full-time job and will treat our business like their own.



What you'll do

* Own the company inbox: read, sort, and respond to
s, draft replies for the founder's review, and make sure nothing gets dropped

* Handle client follow-ups: politely chase replies, confirmations, and missing information

* Billing support: prepare and send invoices, track which invoices are paid, and follow up on unpaid ones. (You will NOT handle bank accounts or move any money. A bookkeeper handles that.)

* Manage the founder's calendar: schedule meetings, send reminders, avoid conflicts

* Keep our CRM updated: client records, notes, and pipeline status

* Data entry, document preparation, and meeting notes

* Later, after training and once you're comfortable: answering some inbound phone calls





How we work (read this carefully)

* Fast communication is the #1 requirement of this job. During working hours, we expect quick replies on chat. If you tend to disappear for hours, this is not the job for you.

* Before starting any task, confirm you understand it. If anything is unclear, ask first. Never guess and never go silent on a task you're stuck on.

* Everything you do gets documented. You'll send a short end-of-day summary every day: what you completed, what's in progress, what's pending, and what you're waiting on from others.





Must have

* Excellent written English. Most of your day is writing
s to American clients.

* At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a VA, secretary, or executive assistant, preferably for US clients

* Extremely detail-oriented and organized. You're the person who notices the missing attachment.

* Fast, proactive communicator. You reply quickly, ask questions early, and never leave people wondering where things stand.

* A friendly, positive, can-do attitude. Your default is "yes, I'll figure it out," not "that's not my job."

* Able to work Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours, full-time

* Reliable high-speed internet, your own computer, backup power/internet plan, and a quiet workspace

* Comfortable in both the Google and Microsoft ecosystems (Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs/Sheets, plus Outlook, Word, Excel), and willing to learn our CRM and invoicing tools



Nice to have

* Background with or exposure to tech/software companies (IT services, SaaS, agencies). It helps you understand our world faster, but it is not required. We'll train the right person.

* Experience with invoicing or billing follow-up

* Comfortable speaking on the phone in English



Trial period

This is a direct hire, not a test project. The first 30 days are a paid trial period. During that time, either side is free to d
 it's not the right match, no hard feelings. After that, you're a permanent part of the team.



What we offer

* Stable full-time salary, paid reliably, plus 13th month pay

* Direct access to the founder and real responsibility from day one

* Training on all our tools and processes



How to apply

Put the word TEAL as the first word of your application so we know you read the whole post. Then answer these questions:



1. Describe your experience managing
 for a US client or employer.

2. Have you prepared or sent invoices before? Describe what you did.

3. What tools have you used in the past to keep your daily work organized (task lists, notes, trackers, etc.), and how did you use them?

4. Confirm you can work Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours, full-time, and tell us your current internet speed (screenshot of a speed test is a plus).

5. In 2 to 3 sentences, write the exact
 reply you would send to a client who says: "I never received last month's invoice."



Applications without the keyword or the answers will not be considered. Fast, clear, complete applications get interviewed first. That's how the job works too.

title: Founding Build Partner: Voice Al Platform (Unicorn, or Lead + Counterpart) | Rev Share + Exit Stake | Deciding in 48 Hou
description:
THE SHORT VERSION I am hiring ONE accountable technical lead to build TalkTuit, a voice AI receptionist that answers every call for plumbing and HVAC companies, books the job, and hands the owner their evenings back. You can be the rare engineer who covers the whole build alone, or a strong specialist who brings a trusted counterpart for your weaker side. Either way, I contract one accountable lead. Compensation is a monthly base plus revenue share plus a real exit stake, structure discussed after a small PAID audition. I am making my decision within 24 to 48 hours.

WHY THIS EXISTS I am a quadriplegic founder. I run this entire company by voice, every
, every document, every line of this ad. Before my injury I worked in the trades alongside family and friends, so I know exactly what happens when a plumber is elbow-deep in a job and the phone rings: the call gets missed, and a missed call is a lost job. TalkTuit exists so no tradesperson loses work because they were busy doing the work. You would not just be building software. You would be building the system that runs a company its founder physically cannot run by hand, which means automation here is not a buzzword, it is the whole point. If the machine we build together works, it changes what people believe a founder like me can build, and it gets acquired for real money that you share in.

WHAT YOU ARE BUILDING (the honest scope) Phase 0.5, about two weeks: one real paying client live on an off-the-shelf voice platform (Retell, Vapi, or Synthflow), one CRM integration, Stripe billing, owner text and
 summaries after every call, schema-enforced call records, and a fallback path so no call is ever dropped. Small on purpose. It earns the first dollars. Phase 1, realistic six to ten weeks: the productized platform on AWS: multi-client provisioning, an any-CRM adapter pattern, onboarding intake, production data layer, CI/CD, secrets, observability, and the security baseline. Later phases (retention systems, scale automation, back office, exit readiness) are revenue-funded roadmap, shown so you can architect for them, not bid them now. Two tracks, one lead. Track A: platform and security engineering (AWS, IaC, CI/CD, secrets, observability, cost, security baseline). Track B: product and automation engineering (the voice agent, telephony logic, CRM and calendar integrations, the auto-demo engine later, n8n workflows, Stripe, the data layer in code). A full PRD with measurable acceptance gates goes to serious candidates.

HOW SELECTION WORKS (proof over prose)

 You reply using the format below. Most of the vetting happens right there.

 Live proof: a voice agent at a real phone number I can call, not a video, not a link to someone else's work.

 A small PAID audition (fixed fee, about a week of scope): provision a number, stand up a demo agent from a website I give you, write schema-valid call records, text me a summary. You get paid either way. I judge shipped work, not claims.

 Winner signs IP assignment, confidentiality, and non-solicit before the first larger dollar, then Phase 0.5 begins immediately. I am non-technical and voice-first, so an independent senior engineer reviews finalist evidence. Please do not waste both our time with borrowed demos.

WHAT MAKES A YES Honesty about your limits beats confidence theater. The last two people who impressed me most told me what they could NOT do. Clear written English, daily communication, least-privilege security habits (you will never hold root, and that protects you as much as me), and pride in building systems that outlive your involvement.

COMPENSATION Monthly base plus revenue share plus exit stake, tied to shipped milestones with vesting. Real structure and numbers are discussed after the paid audition, not before, and never in public. If you need the security of a large salary today, this is honestly not your role. If you want ownership economics in a company you build the engine for, keep reading and reply.

HOW TO REPLY (required format, this is the interview) Start your message with the word BUILT so I know you read this. Your reply must contain all four of these, and a reply missing any one reads as a pass:

 Your LinkedIn profile link.

 Your resume or CV, attached or linked.

 Your portfolio, GitHub, or links to live work.

 Your answers to everything below. Send all four by
 to 
 with a subject line that starts with BUILT. Applications through the job board reach me too, but
 is the fast lane and the one I score first. Then:

 Your lane: UNICORN (both tracks), TRACK A LEAD (infrastructure and security, bringing a Track B counterpart), or TRACK B LEAD (product and AI, bringing a Track A counterpart). If you bring a counterpart, name who is the accountable lead and one thing you two shipped together.

 The skill scale below, rated 1 to 5. RULE: any 4 or 5 must include one line of proof: a link, a named system you built, or a specific problem you hit and fixed. A 4 or 5 with no proof line reads as a 2. a. AWS architecture and IaC (Terraform or CDK) b. CI/CD, secrets management, observability c. Security engineering and compliance awareness (least privilege, encryption, audit logging; SOC 2 or ISO 27001 preparation experience is a plus, name it with proof) d. Production voice AI (Retell, Vapi, Synthflow, or comparable) e. LLM prompt and tool-use design f. CRM or calendar integration by API and webhook (name the CRM, the endpoint, and one failure you hit: rate limits, webhook retries, token refresh, dedup) g. Workflow automation (n8n, Make, or code) h. Stripe or payments integration i. Backend engineering (Python or Node) j. Telephony (Twilio or Telnyx: provisioning, forwarding, recording)

 A phone number with a live voice agent I can call this week, OR the words "will build it in the paid audition."

 Your realistic timeline and price, quoted SEPARATELY for: the paid audition, Phase 0.5, Phase 1. Do not blend them. Blended quotes are declined.

 One paragraph: the production system you are proudest of, what broke in it once, and how you found out.

 Your hours available per week and your time zone overlap with US Eastern. Honest 3s with proof beat unproven 5s here. I reply to shortlisted candidates within 24 hours and choose within 48.

title: Workflow Coordinator for US Install Company
description:
Full-Time | 40–50 Hours Per Week | Weekly Pay



 **Do you love organizing chaos?**



Are you the person everyone relies on because you never let things get forgotten?



Do you naturally follow up with people until things are finished?



Do you enjoy bringing order to busy, fast-moving environments?



If you're reading those questions and thinking...



**"That's me."**



...keep reading.



We believe this could become one of the most important positions in our company.



---



This Is NOT a Typical Virtual Assistant Position



We're looking for someone to become our **Workflow Coordinator**.



Your job isn't to install security cameras.



Your job isn't to manage projects.



Your job isn't to tell people what to do.



**Your job is to keep our company moving.**



Every day, you'll help make sure commitments are completed, projects continue moving forward, and nothing falls through the cracks.



You'll become the person who always knows:



* What's behind.

* What's blocked.

* What still needs to be done.

* Who needs help.

* What leadership should know.



You become the eyes and ears of our operation.



---

What You'll Actually Do



You'll work closely with our leadership team, project managers, technicians, schedulers, and office staff.



Some of your daily responsibilities will include:



* Following up with technicians before, during, and after installations.

* Making sure required paperwork and photos have been uploaded.

* Checking that equipment has been brought online.

* Monitoring project portals for work that hasn't been scheduled.

* Attending our weekly operations meetings.

* Taking detailed meeting notes.

* Tracking action items assigned during meetings.

* Following up until those action items are completed.

* Helping identify problems before they become emergencies.

* Keeping leadership informed about what's happening across the company.



You won't assume something has been completed.



You'll verify it.



---



We Don't Just Want Updates...



We Want Someone Who Thinks.



If you notice:



* technicians forgetting the same paperwork...

* projects repeatedly falling behind...

* communication breaking down...

* recurring mistakes...

* delays that keep happening...



...we don't just want you to tell us.



We want you to help us understand **why** it's happening.



You'll work directly with leadership to improve our systems, solve recurring problems, and make the company better every week.



Your ideas matter here.



---



 We Will Train You Personally



You do **NOT** need experience with security cameras.



You do **NOT** need construction experience.



We'll personally train you from the ground up.



We're hiring for organization, ownership, curiosity, and follow-through.



We'll teach you everything else.



---



The Person We're Looking For



You may be perfect for this role if you:



* Love organization.

* Naturally make lists and checklists.

* Notice details other people miss.

* Enjoy following up with people.

* Stay calm when there are lots of moving pieces.

* Like helping teams stay organized.

* Are comfortable asking questions.

* Don't stop after asking once—you follow through until the task is completed.

* Take pride in helping other people succeed.



If people describe you as "the organized one," we'd love to meet you.



---



Schedule



* **40–50 hours per week**

* Must be available during **U.S. Pacific Time business hours** We can find the hours that work for us both!

* 9AM PST to 7PM PST is ideal but we can figure it out for the correct person for the role. We may be able to find something closer to CST hours as well.

* Weekly pay

* Long-term position with opportunities for growth





---



Before You Apply



We'd like you to answer one question.



There isn't a perfect answer.



We're interested in **how you think.**



Scenario



Imagine it's Monday morning.



You begin your workday and discover the following:



* 18 technicians are working in the field today.

* 5 projects haven't been scheduled.

* 3 technicians forgot to upload required paperwork yesterday.

* Two installations are behind schedule.

* Last week's meeting created 12 action items for different tea
mbers.

* Three of those action items are now overdue.

* One customer is waiting for an update.

* One technician is waiting on equipment.

* Several tea
mbers have already messaged you asking for help.



You cannot solve every problem yourself.



Your job is to help keep the company moving.



Tell us:



* What would you do first?

* How would you organize your day?

* How would you d
 what needs attention first?

* How would you make sure nothing gets forgotten?

* What system would you use to track everything?

* How would you communicate with the team?

* If you noticed the same problem happening over and over again, what would you do?



There isn't a right answer.



We're looking for someone who naturally thinks in systems, organization, follow-through, communication, and continuous improvement.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Graphic Designer — Production & Brand
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We need a production-grade graphic designer who combines the execution speed of a machine with genuine design thinking. You'll be handling a high volume of templated design work — social ads, website banners, PDFs — while also being the person who catches when something 'just looks wrong' and knows how to fix it.

We've worked with designers before who treated our briefs literally and produced mediocre work. We're not looking for someone to fill a template with text and call it done. We want someone who considers layout, typography, iconography, color hierarchy, and image selection as a unified system — and brings that discipline to every asset, no matter how routine.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Recurring Production Work

• Update monthly
 ad templates: swap in new unit images, pricing, and copy

• Produce banners for social media and website placements across both our Canadian and US-facing brands

• Maintain and update a library of PDF documents — price sheets, information guides, multilingual materials — correcting errors, updating pricing, and improving layout as needed

Design System Stewardship

• Own and maintain our Figma file library: templates, brand assets, component sets

• Source and vet Figma assets, marketplace templates, and stock imagery — with a genuine aesthetic eye for what works

• Ensure consistency in typography, color, and image treatment across all assets

Design Thinking & Layout Improvement

• When given a brief, think past the literal request — consider how content should be grouped, what visual hierarchy makes it easiest to read, and whether icons or supporting graphics could help

• Apply this thinking to both new and legacy assets: our best work has come from rethinking the structure, not just prettifying what exists

Freelancer Coordination

• Source and manage Fiverr or similar freelancers for specialized work (custom illustrations, diagrams, etc.)

• Brief external creators, review their output against our standards, and manage revisions

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Proficiency in Figma, Adobe InDesign, and Adobe Illustrator — not just familiarity, but genuine fluency

• Strong sense of layout, grid systems, typographic hierarchy, and color

• Ability to select and crop images well — this matters more than people expect

• Experience with template-based production at volume

• Reliable, deadline-driven, and communicative — if something comes up, you say so



Please add Rockstar in your Message.
